```tsx
import {FormEvent, useState} from 'react';
import {Plus, X} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  EXAM_QUESTION_CHAPTERS,
  LECTURES,
  MATAN_QUESTION_CHAPTERS,
  RK_QUESTION_CHAPTERS,
} from '../data';
import {
  LectureId,
  QuestionChapter,
  StudyCategory,
  TheoryCard,
} from '../types/study';

interface CustomCardModalProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  nextId: number;
  onSave: (card: TheoryCard) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function CustomCardModal({
  category,
  nextId,
  onSave,
  onClose,
}: CustomCardModalProps) {
  const availableChapters: QuestionChapter[] =
    category === 'rk'
      ? [...RK_QUESTION_CHAPTERS]
      : category === 'matan'
        ? [...MATAN_QUESTION_CHAPTERS]
        : category.startsWith('custom_')
          ? ['Основной раздел', 'Теория и определения', 'Формулы и задачи']
          : [...EXAM_QUESTION_CHAPTERS];
  const availableLectures =
    category === 'rk'
      ? LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category === 'rk')
      : category === 'matan'
        ? LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category === 'matan')
        : LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category !== 'rk' && l.category !== 'matan');

  const isMathCategory =
    category === 'rk' || category === 'matan' || category.startsWith('custom_');

  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [chapter, setChapter] = useState<QuestionChapter>(availableChapters[0]);
  const [keyThesis, setKeyThesis] = useState('');
  const [pointsText, setPointsText] = useState('');
  const [codeTitle, setCodeTitle] = useState(
    isMathCategory ? 'Формула / ход доказательства' : 'Пример кода C/C++',
  );
  const [codeBody, setCodeBody] = useState('');
  const [examTip, setExamTip] = useState('');
  const [hint, setHint] = useState('');
  const [quizKeyword, setQuizKeyword] = useState('');
  const [lectureId, setLectureId] = useState<LectureId>(
    category === 'rk'
      ? 'rk2_angeom'
      : category === 'matan'
        ? 'matan_theory'
        : 'lec1',
  );
  const [slidePage, setSlidePage] = useState<number>(1);
  const [slideLabel, setSlideLabel] = useState<string>('Слайд конспекта');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const selectedLecture =
    LECTURES.find((l) => l.id === lectureId) ?? availableLectures[0] ?? LECTURES[0];

  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const qClean = question.trim();
    const thesisClean = keyThesis.trim();
    if (!qClean || !thesisClean) {
      setError('Заполните формулировку вопроса и главный тезис ответа.');
      return;
    }

    const answerPoints = pointsText
      .split('\n')
      .map((line) => line.replace(/^\s*[-•\d.)]+\s*/, '').trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    const safePage = Math.max(
      1,
      Math.min(Number(slidePage) || 1, selectedLecture.pageCount),
    );

    const newCard: TheoryCard = {
      id: nextId,
      category,
      badgeLabel: `Своя карточка №${nextId}`,
      question: qClean,
      chapter,
      keyThesis: thesisClean,
      answerPoints:
        answerPoints.length > 0 ? answerPoints : [thesisClean],
      codeSnippet: codeBody.trim()
        ? {
            title:
              codeTitle.trim() ||
              (isMathCategory ? 'Математическая запись' : 'Пример кода'),
            code: codeBody.trim(),
          }
        : undefined,
      examTip:
        examTip.trim() ||
        'Обратите внимание на точную формулировку и граничные случаи при ответе.',
      hint: hint.trim() || undefined,
      quizKeyword: quizKeyword.trim() || undefined,
      slides: [
        {
          lectureId,
          page: safePage,
          label: slideLabel.trim() || `${selectedLecture.shortTitle}, с. ${safePage}`,
          isAnswerSlide: true,
        },
      ],
      coverage: 'custom',
      isCustom: true,
    };

    onSave(newCard);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-xs p-4"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Добавить свою карточку"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0E1522]">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
              Добавить свою карточку в колоду (№ {nextId})
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
              Карточка сохраняется в браузере, участвует в SM-2 повторении и блиц-тестах
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200/60 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:bg-[#182235] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Закрыть окно"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-4">
          {error && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
              {error}
            </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] mb-1">

            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={question}
              onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Например: Отличие передачи параметра по указателю и по ссылке"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] mb-1">

              <select

              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] mb-1">

            </label>
            <textarea

              onChange={(e) => setKeyThesis(e.target.value)}

              className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"

              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >

            <button

            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />

            </button>

      </div>

  );
```

## FILE: src/components/DrawingScratchpad.tsx

```tsx
import {PointerEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  Eraser,
  Grid,
  PenTool,
  Send,
  Trash2,
  Undo2,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DrawingScratchpadProps {
  taskKey: string;
  onSendToPhotoCheck?: (dataUrl: string) => void;
}

interface StrokePoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

interface Stroke {
  color: string;
  width: number;
  isEraser: boolean;
  points: StrokePoint[];
}

const PEN_COLORS = [
  {id: 'ink', label: 'Тёмный', value: '#1e293b'},
  {id: 'blue', label: 'Синяя ручка', value: '#0284c7'},
  {id: 'red', label: 'Красный', value: '#dc2626'},
  {id: 'green', label: 'Зелёный', value: '#059669'},
];

export function DrawingScratchpad({
  taskKey,
  onSendToPhotoCheck,
}: DrawingScratchpadProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const [strokes, setStrokes] = useState<Stroke[]>([]);
  const [activeColor, setActiveColor] = useState<string>('#0284c7');
  const [isEraser, setIsEraser] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showGrid, setShowGrid] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [penSize, setPenSize] = useState<number>(2.5);
  const drawingRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const currentStrokeRef = useRef<Stroke | null>(null);

  // Reset strokes when switching to a different task
  useEffect(() => {
    setStrokes([]);
    currentStrokeRef.current = null;
    drawingRef.current = false;
  }, [taskKey]);

  const redrawCanvas = useCallback(
    (strokeList: Stroke[], draftStroke?: Stroke | null) => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;

      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      const cssW = canvas.clientWidth || 680;
      const cssH = canvas.clientHeight || 320;
      if (
        canvas.width !== Math.floor(cssW * dpr) ||
        canvas.height !== Math.floor(cssH * dpr)
      ) {
        canvas.width = Math.floor(cssW * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(cssH * dpr);
      }

      ctx.save();
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

      // Crisp white notebook paper background (ideal both visually and for multimodal AI OCR)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cssW, cssH);

      if (showGrid) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        const step = 22;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = step; x < cssW; x += step) {
          ctx.moveTo(x + 0.5, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(x + 0.5, cssH);
        }
        for (let y = step; y < cssH; y += step) {
          ctx.moveTo(0, y + 0.5);
          ctx.lineTo(cssW, y + 0.5);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const drawOne = (s: Stroke) => {
        if (s.points.length === 0) return;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.isEraser ? '#ffffff' : s.color;
        ctx.lineWidth = s.isEraser ? 18 : s.width;

        if (s.points.length === 1) {
          ctx.arc(s.points[0].x, s.points[0].y, ctx.lineWidth / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle;
          ctx.fill();
          return;
        }

        ctx.moveTo(s.points[0].x, s.points[0].y);
        for (let i = 1; i < s.points.length; i++) {
          ctx.lineTo(s.points[i].x, s.points[i].y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      };

      for (const s of strokeList) drawOne(s);
      if (draftStroke) drawOne(draftStroke);

      ctx.restore();
    },
    [showGrid],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    redrawCanvas(strokes);
  }, [strokes, redrawCanvas]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => redrawCanvas(strokes);
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [strokes, redrawCanvas]);

  const getPoint = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>): StrokePoint => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: e.clientX - rect.left,
      y: e.clientY - rect.top,
    };
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    drawingRef.current = true;
    const pt = getPoint(e);
    currentStrokeRef.current = {
      color: activeColor,
      width: penSize,
      isEraser,
      points: [pt],
    };
    redrawCanvas(strokes, currentStrokeRef.current);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!drawingRef.current || !currentStrokeRef.current) return;
    const pt = getPoint(e);
    currentStrokeRef.current.points.push(pt);
    redrawCanvas(strokes, currentStrokeRef.current);
  };

  const finishStroke = () => {
    if (!drawingRef.current || !currentStrokeRef.current) return;
    const finished = currentStrokeRef.current;
    drawingRef.current = false;
    currentStrokeRef.current = null;
    setStrokes((prev) => [...prev, finished]);
  };

  const handleUndo = () => {
    setStrokes((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1));
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    setStrokes([]);
  };

  const handleExportToChecker = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !onSendToPhotoCheck) return;
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    onSendToPhotoCheck(dataUrl);
  };

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3 space-y-2.5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          {PEN_COLORS.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              type="button"
              title={c.label}
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveColor(c.value);
                setIsEraser(false);
              }}
              className={`h-6 w-6 rounded-full border-2 transition-transform cursor-pointer ${
                !isEraser && activeColor === c.value
                  ? 'border-sky-500 scale-110'
                  : 'border-white dark:border-white/[0.08]'
              }`}
              style={{backgroundColor: c.value}}
            />
          ))}

          <span className="mx-1 text-slate-300 dark:text-[#404040]">|</span>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsEraser(false)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border cursor-pointer ${
              !isEraser
                ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-200'
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
            }`}
          >
            <PenTool className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Ручка</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsEraser(true)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border cursor-pointer ${
              isEraser
                ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-950/40 dark:text-sky-200'
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
            }`}
          >
            <Eraser className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Ластик</span>
          </button>

          <select
            value={penSize}
            onChange={(e) => setPenSize(Number(e.target.value))}
            aria-label="Толщина ручки"
            className="px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value={2}>Тонкая</option>
            <option value={2.5}>Обычная</option>
            <option value={4}>Толстая</option>
          </select>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowGrid((g) => !g)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border cursor-pointer ${
              showGrid
                ? 'border-slate-400 bg-white text-slate-900 dark:border-[#555] dark:bg-[#222] dark:text-[#F3F4F6]'
                : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-500'
            }`}
          >
            <Grid className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Клетка</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={strokes.length === 0}
            onClick={handleUndo}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
          >

          >

            >
              <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Отправить черновик на проверку</span>

        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#3A3A3A] overflow-hidden bg-white">
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerUp={finishStroke}
          onPointerCancel={finishStroke}
          className="block w-full h-[280px] sm:h-[320px] touch-none cursor-crosshair"
        />
      </div>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
        Рисуйте мышью, стилусом или пальцем. После решения нажмите «Отправить черновик на проверку» для пошагового аудита.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';

interface ExamSimulatorProps {

  onSetTaskMastery: (taskId: string, status: TaskMasteryStatus) => void;
  onOpenOralExam?: (card: TheoryCard) => void;

interface SimulatorTheoryItem {
  card: TheoryCard;
  maxPoints: number;

}

interface SimulatorTaskItem {
  task: TaskCard;

}

interface GeneratedTicket {
  ticketCode: string;
  theory: SimulatorTheoryItem[];
  practice: SimulatorTaskItem[];
}

function pickRandom<T>(arr: T[], count: number): T[] {
  const copy = [...arr];
  for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
  }
  return copy.slice(0, Math.min(count, copy.length));
}

function generateTicket(
  category: StudyCategory,
  allCards: TheoryCard[],
  tasks: TaskCard[],
): GeneratedTicket {
  const ticketNum = Math.floor(10 + Math.random() * 89);

  if (category === 'rk') {
    const basicTheory = allCards.filter((c) => c.id >= 201 && c.id <= 224);
    const proofTheory = allCards.filter((c) => c.id >= 225 && c.id <= 232);

    const chosenBasicTheory = pickRandom(basicTheory, 3).map((card, i) => ({
      card,
      maxPoints: 1,
      label: `Теория · Базовый вопрос №${i + 1} (1 балл)`,
    }));
    const chosenProof = pickRandom(proofTheory, 1).map((card) => ({
      card,
      maxPoints: 2,
      label: 'Теория · Повышенная сложность / доказательство (2 балла)',
    }));

    // 4 basic tasks (7 pts each = 28) + 2 advanced/hard tasks (9 pts each = 18) = 46 pts max
    const sevenPtPool = tasks.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.kind === 'rk-basic' ||
        (t.kind === 'rk-ticket' && t.badgeNumber.includes('7 баллов')),
    );
    const ninePtPool = tasks.filter(
      (t) =>
        t.kind === 'rk-advanced' ||
        (t.kind === 'rk-ticket' && t.badgeNumber.includes('9 баллов')),
    );

    const chosenSeven = pickRandom(sevenPtPool, 4).map((task, i) => ({
      task,
      maxPoints: 7,
      label: `Задача №${i + 1} (7 баллов)`,
    }));
    const chosenNine = pickRandom(ninePtPool, 2).map((task, i) => ({
      task,
      maxPoints: 9,
      label: `Задача №${i + 5} (9 баллов)`,
    }));

    return {
      ticketCode: `РК2-${ticketNum}`,
      theory: [...chosenBasicTheory, ...chosenProof],
      practice: [...chosenSeven, ...chosenNine],
    };
  }

  if (category === 'matan') {
    const theorems = allCards.filter((c) => c.id >= 501 && c.id <= 549);
    const definitions = allCards.filter((c) => c.id >= 551 && c.id <= 598);

    const firstTh = pickRandom(theorems, 1)[0];
    const otherChapTh = firstTh
      ? theorems.filter((c) => c.chapter !== firstTh.chapter)
      : theorems;
    const secondTh = pickRandom(
      otherChapTh.length > 0 ? otherChapTh : theorems,
      1,
    )[0];
    const chosenDef = pickRandom(definitions, 1)[0];

    const theoryItems: SimulatorTheoryItem[] = [];
    if (firstTh) {
      theoryItems.push({
        card: firstTh,
        maxPoints: 5,
        label: 'Теория · Экзаменационный вопрос №1 (5 баллов)',
      });
    }
    if (secondTh) {
      theoryItems.push({
        card: secondTh,
        maxPoints: 5,
        label: 'Теория · Экзаменационный вопрос №2 (другой раздел · 5 баллов)',
      });
    }
    if (chosenDef) {
      theoryItems.push({
        card: chosenDef,
        maxPoints: 4,
        label: 'Теория · Базовое определение (4 балла)',
      });
    }

    const setConfigs = [
      {kind: 'matan-1' as const, pts: 5, label: 'Задача №1 · Пределы (5 баллов)'},
      {kind: 'matan-2' as const, pts: 5, label: 'Задача №2 · Сравнение б.м./б.б. (5 баллов)'},
      {kind: 'matan-3' as const, pts: 5, label: 'Задача №3 · Непрерывность и разрывы (5 баллов)'},
      {kind: 'matan-4' as const, pts: 6, label: 'Задача №4 · Касательная и Тейлор (6 баллов)'},
      {kind: 'matan-5' as const, pts: 5, label: 'Задача №5 · Монотонность и выпуклость (5 баллов)'},
    ];

    const practiceItems: SimulatorTaskItem[] = [];
    for (const cfg of setConfigs) {
      const pool = tasks.filter((t) => t.kind === cfg.kind);
      const picked = pickRandom(pool, 1)[0];
      if (picked) {
        practiceItems.push({
          task: picked,
          maxPoints: cfg.pts,
          label: cfg.label,
        });
      }
    }

    return {
      ticketCode: `G22-${ticketNum}`,
      theory: theoryItems,
      practice: practiceItems,
    };
  }

  // Custom imported PDF subject: 3 theory questions
  if (category.startsWith('custom_')) {
    const picked = pickRandom(allCards, 3).map((card, i) => ({
      card,
      maxPoints: 5,
      label: `Теория · Вопрос №${i + 1} (5 баллов)`,
    }));
    return {
      ticketCode: `PDF-${ticketNum}`,
      theory: picked,
      practice: [],
    };
  }

  // Exam (АИП): 2 official theory questions from distinct chapters + 1 official exam task
  const official50 = allCards.filter((c) => c.id >= 1 && c.id <= 50);
  const firstQ = pickRandom(official50, 1)[0];
  const otherChapterPool = firstQ
    ? official50.filter((c) => c.chapter !== firstQ.chapter)
    : official50;
  const secondQ = pickRandom(
    otherChapterPool.length > 0 ? otherChapterPool : official50,
    1,
  )[0];

  const examTasks = tasks.filter((t) => t.kind === 'exam');
  const chosenExamTask = pickRandom(
    examTasks.length > 0 ? examTasks : tasks,
    1,
  )[0];

  const theoryItems: SimulatorTheoryItem[] = [];
  if (firstQ) {
    theoryItems.push({
      card: firstQ,
      maxPoints: 2,
      label: 'Вопрос 1 (теория · 2 балла)',
    });
  }
  if (secondQ) {
    theoryItems.push({
      card: secondQ,
      maxPoints: 2,
      label: 'Вопрос 2 (теория · другая глава · 2 балла)',
    });
  }

  const practiceItems: SimulatorTaskItem[] = chosenExamTask
    ? [
        {
          task: chosenExamTask,
          maxPoints: 1,
          label: 'Практическая задача экзамена (1 балл)',
        },
      ]
    : [];

  return {
    ticketCode: `АИП-${ticketNum}`,
    theory: theoryItems,
    practice: practiceItems,
  };
}

export function ExamSimulator({
  category,
  allCards,
  tasks,
  onRateCard,
  onSetTaskMastery,
  onOpenOralExam,
}: ExamSimulatorProps) {
  const [ticket, setTicket] = useState<GeneratedTicket>(() =>
    generateTicket(category, allCards, tasks),
  );
  const [timerPresetMin, setTimerPresetMin] = useState<0 | 45 | 60 | 90>(60);
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState<number>(60 * 60);
  const [timerRunning, setTimerRunning] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Per-theory-item state
  const [theoryAnswers, setTheoryAnswers] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [theoryEvals, setTheoryEvals] = useState<
    Record<number, AnswerEvaluationResult>
  >({});
  const [theoryScores, setTheoryScores] = useState<Record<number, number>>({});
  const [theoryRevealed, setTheoryRevealed] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>(
    {},
  );
  const [evaluatingCardId, setEvaluatingCardId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [recordingCardId, setRecordingCardId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Per-practice-task state
  const [taskInputs, setTaskInputs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [taskFeedbacks, setTaskFeedbacks] = useState<
    Record<string, {isCorrect: boolean; feedback: string}>
  >({});
  const [taskScores, setTaskScores] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [taskSolutionOpen, setTaskSolutionOpen] = useState<
    Record<string, boolean>
  >({});
  const [taskScratchOpen, setTaskScratchOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [taskPhotoOpen, setTaskPhotoOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [taskGraphOpen, setTaskGraphOpen] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [taskScratchImg, setTaskScratchImg] = useState<Record<string, string | null>>({});

  const [showFinalVerdict, setShowFinalVerdict] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const recorderRef = useRef<HybridVoiceRecorderHandle | null>(null);

  const resetForTicket = (next: GeneratedTicket, presetMin = timerPresetMin) => {
    void recorderRef.current?.stop();
    recorderRef.current = null;
    setRecordingCardId(null);
    setTicket(next);
    setTheoryAnswers({});
    setTheoryEvals({});
    setTheoryScores({});
    setTheoryRevealed({});
    setTaskInputs({});
    setTaskFeedbacks({});
    setTaskScores({});
    setTaskSolutionOpen({});
    setShowFinalVerdict(false);
    setTimerRunning(false);
    setSecondsLeft(presetMin * 60);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const defaultMin =
      category === 'matan' ? 90 : category === 'rk' ? 60 : 45;
    setTimerPresetMin(defaultMin);
    resetForTicket(generateTicket(category, allCards, tasks), defaultMin);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [category]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!timerRunning || timerPresetMin === 0) return;
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setSecondsLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          setTimerRunning(false);
          setShowFinalVerdict(true);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [timerRunning, timerPresetMin]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      void recorderRef.current?.stop();
    };
  }, []);

  const handleToggleVoiceForCard = async (card: TheoryCard) => {
    if (recordingCardId === card.id) {
      const handle = recorderRef.current;
      recorderRef.current = null;
      setRecordingCardId(null);
      if (handle) {
        const finalText = await handle.stop();
        if (finalText) {
          setTheoryAnswers((prev) => ({...prev, [card.id]: finalText}));
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if (recorderRef.current) {
      await recorderRef.current.stop();
      recorderRef.current = null;
    }

    const handle = await startHybridVoiceRecording({
      initialText: theoryAnswers[card.id] ?? '',
      questionContext: card.question,
      onLiveText: (txt) =>
        setTheoryAnswers((prev) => ({...prev, [card.id]: txt})),
      onError: () => {
        setRecordingCardId(null);
      },
      onStop: () => {
        setRecordingCardId(null);
      },
    });
    if (handle) {
      recorderRef.current = handle;
      setRecordingCardId(card.id);
    }
  };

  const handleCheckTheory = async (item: SimulatorTheoryItem) => {
    const cardId = item.card.id;
    let ans = theoryAnswers[cardId] ?? '';
    if (recordingCardId === cardId && recorderRef.current) {
      ans = await recorderRef.current.stop();
      recorderRef.current = null;
      setRecordingCardId(null);
      setTheoryAnswers((prev) => ({...prev, [cardId]: ans}));
    }

    setEvaluatingCardId(cardId);
    try {
      const ev = await evaluateStudentAnswerWithProfessor(item.card, ans);
      setTheoryEvals((prev) => ({...prev, [cardId]: ev}));
      setTheoryRevealed((prev) => ({...prev, [cardId]: true}));

      // Map professor score to official points
      let pts = 0;
      if (item.maxPoints === 1) {
        pts = ev.scorePct >= 55 ? 1 : 0;
      } else if (item.maxPoints === 2) {
        pts = ev.scorePct >= 75 ? 2 : ev.scorePct >= 45 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        pts = Math.round((ev.scorePct / 100) * item.maxPoints);
      }
      setTheoryScores((prev) => ({...prev, [cardId]: pts}));
      onRateCard(cardId, ev.recommendedGrade);
    } finally {
      setEvaluatingCardId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCheckRkTask = (item: SimulatorTaskItem) => {
    const res = checkRkTaskAnswer(item.task.id, taskInputs[item.task.id] ?? '');
    setTaskFeedbacks((prev) => ({...prev, [item.task.id]: res}));
    if (res.isCorrect) {
      setTaskScores((prev) => ({...prev, [item.task.id]: item.maxPoints}));
      onSetTaskMastery(
        item.task.id,
        taskSolutionOpen[item.task.id] ? 'hint' : 'solved',
      );
    }
  };

  const scoreSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const theoryEarned = ticket.theory.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + (theoryScores[item.card.id] ?? 0),
      0,
    );
    const theoryMax = ticket.theory.reduce((sum, i) => sum + i.maxPoints, 0);

    const practiceEarned = ticket.practice.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + (taskScores[item.task.id] ?? 0),
      0,
    );
    const practiceMax = ticket.practice.reduce(
      (sum, i) => sum + i.maxPoints,
      0,
    );

    if (category === 'rk') {
      const theoryPassed = theoryEarned >= 3;
      const practicePassed = practiceEarned >= 27;
      const overallPassed = theoryPassed && practicePassed;
      return {
        theoryEarned,
        theoryMax,
        practiceEarned,
        practiceMax,
        theoryPassed,
        practicePassed,
        overallPassed,
        examGrade: null as number | null,
      };
    }

    if (category === 'matan') {
      const totalPts = theoryEarned + practiceEarned; // max 40 (14 + 26)
      const theoryPassed = theoryEarned >= 8;
      const practicePassed = practiceEarned >= 15;
      const examGrade =
        totalPts >= 34 ? 5 : totalPts >= 26 ? 4 : totalPts >= 18 ? 3 : 2;
      const overallPassed = theoryPassed && practicePassed && examGrade >= 3;
      return {
        theoryEarned,
        theoryMax,
        practiceEarned,
        practiceMax,
        theoryPassed,
        practicePassed,
        overallPassed,
        examGrade,
      };
    }

    const totalPts = theoryEarned + practiceEarned; // max 5
    const examGrade = Math.max(2, Math.min(5, Math.round(totalPts)));
    return {
      theoryEarned,
      theoryMax,
      practiceEarned,
      practiceMax,
      theoryPassed: theoryEarned >= 2,
      practicePassed: practiceEarned >= 1,
      overallPassed: examGrade >= 3,
      examGrade,
    };
  }, [ticket, theoryScores, taskScores, category]);

  const mins = Math.floor(secondsLeft / 60);
  const secs = secondsLeft % 60;
  const formattedClock = `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {/* Top Simulator Control Bar */}
      <section className="prism-surface rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                Билет {ticket.ticketCode}
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
              <span>
                {category === 'rk'
                  ? 'Официальная структура РК 2: Теория (3×1 + 1×2 = 5 б., зачёт ≥ 3) + Задачи (4×7 + 2×9 = 46 б., зачёт ≥ 27)'
                  : category === 'matan'
                    ? 'Структура билета Матан G22 (40 б.): Теория (2×5 + 1×4 = 14 б., порог ≥ 8) + 5 задач (5+5+5+6+5 = 26 б., порог ≥ 15)'
                    : 'Структура экзамена АИП: 2 вопроса теории из разных глав + 1 экзаменационная задача'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-1 text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
              Боевой симулятор билета (
              {category === 'rk'
                ? 'Ангем РК 2'
                : category === 'matan'
                  ? 'Матан · Экзамен G22'
                  : 'Экзамен АИП'}
              )
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            {/* Timer presets */}
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 p-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0B101B]">
              {([45, 60, 90, 0] as const).map((m) => (
                <button
                  key={m}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setTimerPresetMin(m);
                    setTimerRunning(false);
                    setSecondsLeft(m * 60);
                  }}
                  className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono rounded-md cursor-pointer ${
                    timerPresetMin === m
                      ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs dark:bg-[#131B2B] dark:text-[#F3F4F6]'
                      : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {m === 0 ? 'Без тайм.' : `${m}м`}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {timerPresetMin > 0 && (
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B]">
                <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
                <span className="font-mono text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                  {formattedClock}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTimerRunning((r) => !r)}
                  className="p-1 rounded prism-cta cursor-pointer"
                  title={timerRunning ? 'Пауза' : 'Старт таймера'}
                >
                  {timerRunning ? (
                    <Pause className="h-3 w-3" />
                  ) : (
                    <Play className="h-3 w-3" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                resetForTicket(generateTicket(category, allCards, tasks))
              }
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
              <span>Новый билет</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Live Score Strip */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 tabular-nums">
            <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
              Теория:{' '}
              <strong
                className={`font-mono ${
                  scoreSummary.theoryPassed
                    ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                    : 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
                }`}
              >
                {scoreSummary.theoryEarned} / {scoreSummary.theoryMax}
              </strong>
              {category === 'rk'
                ? ' (мин. 3)'
                : category === 'matan'
                  ? ' (мин. 8)'
                  : ''}
            </span>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-slate-300 dark:text-[#404040]">·</span>
            <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
              Практика:{' '}
              <strong
                className={`font-mono ${
                  scoreSummary.practicePassed
                    ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                    : 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
                }`}
              >
                {scoreSummary.practiceEarned} / {scoreSummary.practiceMax}
              </strong>
              {category === 'rk'
                ? ' (мин. 27)'
                : category === 'matan'
                  ? ' (мин. 15)'
                  : ''}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setTimerRunning(false);
              setShowFinalVerdict(true);
            }}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Award className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Подвести итог билета</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Final Verdict Card */}
      {showFinalVerdict && (
        <section
          className={`rounded-xl border-2 p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-2 ${
            scoreSummary.overallPassed
              ? 'border-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-600/70 bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/30'
              : 'border-rose-400 dark:border-rose-600/70 bg-rose-50/70 dark:bg-rose-950/30'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {scoreSummary.overallPassed ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              ) : (
                <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
              )}
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                {category === 'rk'
                  ? scoreSummary.overallPassed
                    ? 'Итог: РК 2 СДАН!'
                    : 'Итог: РК 2 пока НЕ СДАН (не набран порог по части билета)'
                  : category === 'matan'
                    ? scoreSummary.overallPassed
                      ? `Итог Матан: СДАНО · Оценка ${scoreSummary.examGrade} из 5 (${scoreSummary.theoryEarned + scoreSummary.practiceEarned} / 40 б.)`
                      : `Итог Матан: НЕ СДАНО · Оценка 2 (${scoreSummary.theoryEarned + scoreSummary.practiceEarned} / 40 б., не пройден порог)`
                    : `Итоговая экзаменационная оценка: ${scoreSummary.examGrade} из 5`}
              </h3>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                resetForTicket(generateTicket(category, allCards, tasks))
              }
              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta cursor-pointer"
            >
              Вытянуть новый билет
            </button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] tabular-nums">
            {category === 'rk'
              ? `Теория: ${scoreSummary.theoryEarned} из 5 (порог 3 балла — ${
                  scoreSummary.theoryPassed ? 'пройден' : 'не пройден'
                }) · Задачи: ${scoreSummary.practiceEarned} из 46 (порог 27 баллов — ${
                  scoreSummary.practicePassed ? 'пройден' : 'не пройден'
                }).`
              : category === 'matan'
                ? `Теория: ${scoreSummary.theoryEarned} из 14 (порог 8 — ${
                    scoreSummary.theoryPassed ? 'пройден' : 'не пройден'
                  }) · Практика (5 задач G22): ${scoreSummary.practiceEarned} из 26 (порог 15 — ${
                    scoreSummary.practicePassed ? 'пройден' : 'не пройден'
                  }) · Шкала: ≥34 → 5, ≥26 → 4, ≥18 → 3.`
                : `Теория: ${scoreSummary.theoryEarned} из ${scoreSummary.theoryMax} · Практическая задача: ${scoreSummary.practiceEarned} из ${scoreSummary.practiceMax}.`}
          </p>
        </section>
      )}

      {/* Part 1: Theory Questions */}
      <section className="space-y-4">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
          Часть 1 · Теоретические вопросы ({ticket.theory.length})
        </h3>
        {ticket.theory.map((item) => {
          const cardId = item.card.id;
          const ev = theoryEvals[cardId];
          const isOpen = Boolean(theoryRevealed[cardId]);
          const score = theoryScores[cardId] ?? 0;
          const isRec = recordingCardId === cardId;
          const isEval = evaluatingCardId === cardId;

          return (
            <article
              key={cardId}
              className="prism-surface rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-3.5"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                    {item.label}
                  </span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                  <span>{item.card.chapter}</span>
                </div>

                {/* Self-score selector */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">Балл:</span>
                  {Array.from({length: item.maxPoints + 1}, (_, pts) => (
                    <button
                      key={pts}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setTheoryScores((prev) => ({...prev, [cardId]: pts}))
                      }
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 font-mono rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                        score === pts
                          ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-50 text-sky-900 dark:bg-sky-500/20 dark:text-sky-200 font-bold'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {pts}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <h4 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                {item.card.question}
              </h4>

              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={theoryAnswers[cardId] ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setTheoryAnswers((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [cardId]: e.target.value,
                  }))
                }
                placeholder="Напишите или продиктуйте ответ своими словами..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => void handleToggleVoiceForCard(item.card)}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg cursor-pointer ${
                    isRec
                      ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500'
                      : 'border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isRec ? (
                    <>
                      <MicOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Стоп</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Mic className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
                      <span>Голосом</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isEval}
                  onClick={() => void handleCheckTheory(item)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>
                    {isEval ? 'Оценка преподавателя...' : 'Проверить у преподавателя'}
                  </span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setTheoryRevealed((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      [cardId]: !prev[cardId],
                    }))
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isOpen ? (
                    <>
                      <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Скрыть эталон</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Показать эталон</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                {onOpenOralExam && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onOpenOralExam(item.card)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-sky-300 dark:border-sky-600/60 bg-sky-50/70 dark:bg-sky-950/30 text-sky-900 dark:text-sky-200 hover:bg-sky-100 dark:hover:bg-sky-950/50 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <GraduationCap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Сдать устно до конца</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {ev && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0E1522] p-3 text-xs space-y-1">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                    {ev.verdictTitle} ({ev.scorePct}%)
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                    {ev.verdictDetail}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              {isOpen && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-sky-200/80 dark:border-sky-900/50 bg-sky-50/50 dark:bg-sky-950/20 p-3.5 space-y-2 text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                    {item.card.keyThesis}
                  </p>
                  <ul className="space-y-1 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                    {item.card.answerPoints.map((pt, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx}>
                        {idx + 1}. {pt}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                  {item.card.mathFormulaLatex && (
                    <div className="pt-1">
                      <MathBlock
                        latex={item.card.mathFormulaLatex}
                        displayMode={true}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </section>

      {/* Part 2: Practice Tasks */}
      <section className="space-y-4">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
          Часть 2 · Практические задачи ({ticket.practice.length})
        </h3>

        {ticket.practice.map((item) => {
          const t = item.task;
          const fb = taskFeedbacks[t.id];
          const hint = getTaskAnswerHint(t.id);
          const isOpen = Boolean(taskSolutionOpen[t.id]);
          const score = taskScores[t.id] ?? 0;
          const scoreOptions =
            item.maxPoints === 1
              ? [0, 1]
              : item.maxPoints === 5
                ? [0, 2, 3, 5]
                : item.maxPoints === 6
                  ? [0, 2, 4, 6]
                  : item.maxPoints === 7
                    ? [0, 3, 5, 7]
                    : [0, 4, 7, 9];

          return (
            <article
              key={t.id}
              className="prism-surface rounded-2xl p-5 space-y-4"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                    {item.label}
                  </span>
                  <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-slate-400">·</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    {t.title}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">Балл:</span>
                  {scoreOptions.map((pts) => (
                    <button
                      key={pts}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setTaskScores((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: pts}))
                      }
                      className={`px-2 py-0.5 font-mono rounded border cursor-pointer ${
                        score === pts
                          ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-200 font-bold'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {pts}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0E1522] p-4 space-y-2">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                  {t.problemTextClean ?? t.problemStatement}
                </p>
                {t.problemLatex && (
                  <MathBlock latex={t.problemLatex} displayMode={true} />
                )}
                {t.problemTextAfter && (
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                    {t.problemTextAfter}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* RK / Matan Auto Answer Verifier */}
              {(category === 'rk' || category === 'matan') && hint && (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={taskInputs[t.id] ?? ''}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setTaskInputs((prev) => ({
                          ...prev,
                          [t.id]: e.target.value,
                        }))
                      }
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleCheckRkTask(item);
                        }
                      }}
                      placeholder={hint.placeholder}
                      className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleCheckRkTask(item)}
                      className="px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Сверить ответ
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  {fb && (
                    <p
                      className={`text-xs font-medium ${
                        fb.isCorrect
                          ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400'
                          : 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {fb.feedback}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setTaskSolutionOpen((prev) => ({
                      ...prev,
                      [t.id]: !prev[t.id],
                    }))
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isOpen ? (
                    <>
                      <EyeOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Скрыть решение</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Показать решение и ответ</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setTaskScratchOpen((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: !prev[t.id]}))
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <PenTool className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
                  <span>Черновик</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() =>
                    setTaskPhotoOpen((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: !prev[t.id]}))
                  }
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Camera className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
                  <span>Проверка по фото</span>
                </button>

                {hasMatanGraph(t.id) && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setTaskGraphOpen((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: !prev[t.id]}))
                    }
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Activity className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>График</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {hasMatanGraph(t.id) && taskGraphOpen[t.id] && (
                <FunctionGraphCard taskId={t.id} />
              )}

              {taskScratchOpen[t.id] && (
                <DrawingScratchpad
                  taskKey={`${ticket.ticketCode}-${t.id}`}
                  onSendToPhotoCheck={(url) => {
                    setTaskPhotoOpen((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: true}));
                    setTaskScratchImg((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: url}));
                  }}
                />
              )}

              {taskPhotoOpen[t.id] && (
                <PhotoSolutionChecker
                  taskStatement={t.problemStatement}
                  taskLatex={t.problemLatex}
                  algorithmSummary={t.algorithmSummary}
                  expectedOutput={t.expectedOutput}
                  externalImageDataUrl={taskScratchImg[t.id]}
                  onClearExternalImage={() =>
                    setTaskScratchImg((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: null}))
                  }
                  onSolved={() => {
                    setTaskScores((prev) => ({...prev, [t.id]: item.maxPoints}));
                    onSetTaskMastery(t.id, 'solved');
                  }}
                />
              )}

              {isOpen && (
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                    <strong>Идея:</strong> {t.algorithmSummary}
                  </p>
                  {t.explanationSteps.map((step, sIdx) => (
                    <div
                      key={sIdx}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3 space-y-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm"
                    >
                      <p className="font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                        {step.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                        {step.detail}
                      </p>
                      {step.latex && (
                        <MathBlock latex={step.latex} displayMode={true} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {t.answerLatex ? (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700/70 bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-950/25 p-3">
                      <MathBlock latex={t.answerLatex} displayMode={true} />
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <pre className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#070B12] text-slate-100 text-xs font-mono overflow-x-auto">
                      <code>{t.code}</code>
                    </pre>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </article>
          );
        })}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {FormEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Brain,
  CheckCircle2,
  Flag,
  Lightbulb,
  Loader2,
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  RefreshCw,
  Send,
  Sparkles,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {RecallGrade, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {
  HybridVoiceRecorderHandle,
  startHybridVoiceRecording,
} from '../utils/speechAndGrading';

interface FeynmanFreshmanModalProps {
  initialCard: TheoryCard;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  onRateCard: (cardId: number, grade: RecallGrade) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface FeynmanMessage {
  role: 'freshman' | 'teacher';
  text: string;
  jargonAlert?: boolean;
}

interface FeynmanReport {
  understandingPct: number;
  explainedWell: string[];
  illusionGaps: string[];
  recommendedGrade: RecallGrade;
}

const GRADE_LABELS: Record<RecallGrade, string> = {
  again: '1 · Не помню',
  hard: '2 · Сложно',
  good: '3 · Хорошо',
  easy: '4 · Легко',
};

export function FeynmanFreshmanModal({
  initialCard,
  allCards,
  onRateCard,
  onClose,
}: FeynmanFreshmanModalProps) {
  const [card, setCard] = useState<TheoryCard>(initialCard);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<FeynmanMessage[]>([
    {
      role: 'freshman',
      text: `Слушай, выручай 😅 У меня завтра пересдача, а я вообще не вдупляю тему «${initialCard.question}». Только, умоляю, не читай мне сухой учебник — объясни на пальцах, по-человечески, зачем это вообще нужно и как работает!`,
    },
  ]);
  const [understandingPct, setUnderstandingPct] = useState(0);
  const [moodLabel, setMoodLabel] = useState('В полном тумане (0%)');
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [isTranscribing, setIsTranscribing] = useState(false);
  const [voiceEnabled, setVoiceEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [report, setReport] = useState<FeynmanReport | null>(null);
  const [savedGrade, setSavedGrade] = useState<RecallGrade | null>(null);

  const recorderRef = useRef<HybridVoiceRecorderHandle | null>(null);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const teacherTurns = messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'teacher').length;

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({
      top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight,
      behavior: 'smooth',
    });
  }, [messages, isSending, report]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      void recorderRef.current?.stop();
      audioRef.current?.pause();
    };
  }, []);

  const playNaturalFreshmanVoice = async (text: string) => {
    if (!voiceEnabled) return;
    try {
      audioRef.current?.pause();
      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/tts-line', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text,
          voiceName: 'Puck',
          style: 'Natural, lively, moderately brisk Russian university freshman voice, friendly and expressive',
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = (await res.json()) as {audioBase64?: string};
      if (!data.audioBase64) return;
      const audio = new Audio(`data:audio/wav;base64,${data.audioBase64}`);
      audio.playbackRate = 1.1;
      audioRef.current = audio;
      void audio.play();
    } catch {
      // silent fallback
    }
  };

  const stopRecordingIfActive = async (): Promise<string> => {
    const handle = recorderRef.current;
    recorderRef.current = null;
    setIsRecording(false);
    if (!handle) return inputText;
    try {
      return await handle.stop();
    } catch {
      return inputText;
    }
  };

  const handleToggleMic = async () => {
    if (isRecording) {
      const txt = await stopRecordingIfActive();
      setInputText(txt);
      return;
    }
    audioRef.current?.pause();
    setError('');
    const handle = await startHybridVoiceRecording({
      initialText: inputText,
      questionContext: card.question,
      onLiveText: (t) => setInputText(t),
      onTranscribingChange: (flag) => setIsTranscribing(flag),
      onError: (msg) => setError(msg),
      onStop: () => setIsRecording(false),
    });
    if (handle) {
      recorderRef.current = handle;
      setIsRecording(true);
    }
  };

  const sendTurn = async (textToSend: string, finishNow = false) => {
    const clean = textToSend.trim();
    if (!finishNow && !clean) return;
    setError('');
    setIsSending(true);

    const nextMessages: FeynmanMessage[] = clean
      ? [...messages, {role: 'teacher', text: clean}]
      : [...messages];

    if (clean) {
      setMessages(nextMessages);
      setInputText('');
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/feynman-turn', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          card: {
            id: card.id,
            question: card.question,
            chapter: card.chapter,
            keyThesis: card.keyThesis,
            answerPoints: card.answerPoints,
            examTip: card.examTip,
          },
          history: nextMessages.map((m) => ({role: m.role, text: m.text})),
          currentUnderstanding: understandingPct,
          finishNow,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось получить ответ от Дани');
      }
      const data = await res.json();

      const freshmanMsg: FeynmanMessage = {
        role: 'freshman',
        text: data.freshmanReply,
        jargonAlert: Boolean(data.jargonDetected),
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, freshmanMsg]);
      setUnderstandingPct(data.understandingPct);
      setMoodLabel(data.moodLabel);

      if (data.isFinished) {
        setReport({
          understandingPct: data.understandingPct,
          explainedWell: data.explainedWell ?? [],
          illusionGaps: data.illusionGaps ?? [],
          recommendedGrade: data.recommendedGrade ?? 'good',
        });
      }

      void playNaturalFreshmanVoice(data.freshmanReply);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка соединения');
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let finalText = inputText;
    if (isRecording) {
      finalText = await stopRecordingIfActive();
    }
    if (!finalText.trim() || isSending) return;
    await sendTurn(finalText, false);
  };

  const handlePickAnotherCard = () => {
    audioRef.current?.pause();
    const others = allCards.filter((c) => c.id !== card.id);
    const next =
      others.length > 0
        ? others[Math.floor(Math.random() * others.length)]
        : card;
    setCard(next);
    setMessages([
      {
        role: 'freshman',
        text: `Окей, новая тема! Расскажи мне по-человечески про «${next.question}» — только без заученных штампов, на пальцах!`,
      },
    ]);
    setUnderstandingPct(0);
    setMoodLabel('В полном тумане (0%)');
    setInputText('');
    setReport(null);
    setSavedGrade(null);
    setError('');
  };

  const meterColor =
    understandingPct >= 85
      ? 'bg-emerald-500'
      : understandingPct >= 45
        ? 'bg-sky-500'
        : 'bg-amber-500';

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Метод Фейнмана наоборот: объясни первокурснику"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Brain className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] truncate">
                Метод Фейнмана · Объясни первокурснику Дане
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] truncate">
                Билет №{card.id}: {card.question}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                const next = !voiceEnabled;
                setVoiceEnabled(next);
                if (!next) audioRef.current?.pause();
              }}
              title={voiceEnabled ? 'Выключить озвучку Дани' : 'Включить живой голос Дани'}
              className={`p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs cursor-pointer ${
                voiceEnabled
                  ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-950/40 text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-300'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
              }`}
            >
              {voiceEnabled ? <Volume2 className="h-4 w-4" /> : <VolumeX className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePickAnotherCard}
              title="Другой билет"
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Закрыть"
              className="p-2 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Understanding Meter Bar */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0E1522] space-y-1.5 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
              Понимание первокурсника: <span className="text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">{moodLabel}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono font-bold tabular-nums text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              {understandingPct}% / 100%
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2.5 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-[#131B2B] overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className={`h-full transition-all duration-500 ${meterColor}`}
              style={{width: `${Math.max(4, understandingPct)}%`}}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Chat Stream */}
        <div
          ref={scrollRef}
          className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-3.5 min-h-[260px]"
        >
          {messages.map((msg, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className={`flex flex-col ${
                msg.role === 'teacher' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'
              }`}
            >
              {msg.jargonAlert && (
                <span className="mb-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
                  Поймал сухой штамп из учебника — объясни на пальцах!
                </span>
              )}
              <div
                className={`max-w-[88%] rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed ${
                  msg.role === 'teacher'
                    ? 'bg-cyan-600/90 dark:bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-500/40 text-white dark:text-cyan-50 rounded-br-sm'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] rounded-bl-sm'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70 mb-1">
                  {msg.role === 'teacher' ? 'Твоё объяснение' : 'Даня (первокурсник)'}
                </div>
                {msg.text}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}

          {isSending && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-amber-500" />
              <span>Даня чешет затылок и пытается переварить объяснение...</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Illusion of Competence Report */}
          {report && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/70 bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/25 p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                    Аудит «Иллюзии понимания» ({report.understandingPct}%)
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  Рекомендация SM-2: {GRADE_LABELS[report.recommendedGrade]}
                </span>
              </div>

              {report.explainedWell.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1">

                  </div>
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-5 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] space-y-0.5">
                    {report.explainedWell.map((item, i) => (
                      <li key={i}>{item}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}

              {report.illusionGaps.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Lightbulb className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Где пряталась «иллюзия понимания» (что дошлифовать):
                  </div>
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-5 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] space-y-0.5">
                    {report.illusionGaps.map((item, i) => (
                      <li key={i}>{item}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                {savedGrade ? (
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    Сохранено в SM-2: {GRADE_LABELS[savedGrade]}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  (['again', 'hard', 'good', 'easy'] as RecallGrade[]).map((g) => (
                    <button
                      key={g}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        onRateCard(card.id, g);
                        setSavedGrade(g);
                      }}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg border cursor-pointer ${
                        g === report.recommendedGrade
                          ? 'prism-tab-active text-slate-900 dark:text-white'
                          : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {GRADE_LABELS[g]}
                    </button>
                  ))
                )}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePickAnotherCard}
                  className="ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-950 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Следующая тема</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/30 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Input Composer */}
        {!report && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0E1522] space-y-2 shrink-0"
          >
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => void handleToggleMic()}
                disabled={isSending || isTranscribing}
                title={isRecording ? 'Остановить запись' : 'Объяснить голосом'}
                className={`h-10 w-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  isRecording
                    ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white animate-pulse'
                    : 'border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#222] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] hover:border-sky-500'
                }`}
              >
                {isTranscribing ? (
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                ) : isRecording ? (
                  <MicOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Mic className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>

              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={inputText}
                onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    void handleSubmit(e);
                  }
                }}
                placeholder="Объясни Дане своими словами, с жизненным примером или интуицией..."
                className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0B101B] px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500 resize-none"
              />

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSending || (!inputText.trim() && !isRecording)}
                className="h-10 px-4 rounded-xl prism-cta disabled:opacity-40 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Объяснить</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
              <span>Раунд {teacherTurns + 1} из 5 · Доведи понимание до 100%</span>
              {teacherTurns >= 1 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isSending}
                  onClick={() => void sendTurn('', true)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Flag className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Завершить и вскрыть «иллюзию понимания»</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
