```tsx
import {MouseEvent, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {Activity} from 'lucide-react';
import {MathBlock} from './MathBlock';

interface FunctionGraphCardProps {
  taskId: string;
}

interface MarkedPoint {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  label: string;
  kind: 'extremum' | 'inflection';
}

interface MatanGraphSpec {
  title: string;
  latex: string;
  fn: (x: number) => number;
  xRange: [number, number];
  yRange: [number, number];
  verticalAsymptotes: number[];
  obliqueAsymptote?: {k: number; b: number; label: string};
  points: MarkedPoint[];
  summary: string;
}

const SQRT2 = Math.SQRT2;
const CBRT4 = Math.cbrt(4);

const MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS: Record<string, MatanGraphSpec> = {
  'matan-5-1': {
    title: 'График исследования f(x) = x⁴ / (x³ − 1)',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^4}{x^3 - 1}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : x ** 4 / (x ** 3 - 1)),
    xRange: [-4.5, 5.5],
    yRange: [-5, 7],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 0, label: 'y = x'},
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'max (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {
        x: CBRT4,
        y: (4 * CBRT4) / 3,
        label: 'min (∛4; 4∛4/3)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x. Локальный max в (0; 0), локальный min в (∛4 ≈ 1.59; 2.12).',
  },
  'matan-5-2': {
    title: 'График f(x) = ln(1 + x²) — экстремумы и выпуклость',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\ln(1 + x^2)',
    fn: (x) => Math.log(1 + x * x),
    xRange: [-4.5, 4.5],
    yRange: [-0.8, 3.6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [],
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'min (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: -1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (−1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
      {x: 1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Чётная функция без асимптот. Минимум в (0; 0); выпукла вниз на (−1; 1), выпукла вверх при |x| > 1; точки перегиба (±1; ln 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-3': {
    title: 'График f(x) = ln(1 + x²) — интервалы выпуклости и перегибы',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\ln(1 + x^2)',
    fn: (x) => Math.log(1 + x * x),
    xRange: [-4.5, 4.5],
    yRange: [-0.8, 3.6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [],
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'min (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: -1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (−1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
      {x: 1, y: Math.LN2, label: 'перегиб (1; ln 2)', kind: 'inflection'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Вторая производная f\'\'(x) = 2(1 − x²)/(1 + x²)² меняет знак в точках x = −1 и x = 1.',
  },
  'matan-5-4': {
    title: 'График f(x) = x² / (2(x − 1))',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2}{2(x - 1)}',
    fn: (x) =>
      Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x) / (2 * (x - 1)),
    xRange: [-4, 6],
    yRange: [-4.5, 6.5],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 0.5, b: 0.5, label: 'y = 0.5x + 0.5'},
    points: [
      {x: 0, y: 0, label: 'max (0; 0)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: 2, y: 2, label: 'min (2; 2)', kind: 'extremum'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x/2 + 1/2. Локальный max (0; 0), локальный min (2; 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-5': {
    title: 'График f(x) = (x² + 1) / x',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x} = x + \\dfrac{1}{x}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x + 1) / x),
    xRange: [-5, 5],
    yRange: [-6, 6],
    verticalAsymptotes: [0],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 0, label: 'y = x'},
    points: [
      {x: -1, y: -2, label: 'max (−1; −2)', kind: 'extremum'},
      {x: 1, y: 2, label: 'min (1; 2)', kind: 'extremum'},
    ],
    summary:
      'Нечётная функция: вертикальная асимптота x = 0, наклонная y = x. Локальный max (−1; −2), локальный min (1; 2).',
  },
  'matan-5-6': {
    title: 'График f(x) = (x² + 1) / (x − 1)',
    latex: 'f(x) = \\dfrac{x^2 + 1}{x - 1}',
    fn: (x) => (Math.abs(x - 1) < 0.025 ? Number.NaN : (x * x + 1) / (x - 1)),
    xRange: [-4, 6],
    yRange: [-5.5, 8.5],
    verticalAsymptotes: [1],
    obliqueAsymptote: {k: 1, b: 1, label: 'y = x + 1'},
    points: [
      {
        x: 1 - SQRT2,
        y: 2 - 2 * SQRT2,
        label: 'max (1−√2; 2−2√2)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
      {
        x: 1 + SQRT2,
        y: 2 + 2 * SQRT2,
        label: 'min (1+√2; 2+2√2)',
        kind: 'extremum',
      },
    ],
    summary:
      'Вертикальная асимптота x = 1, наклонная y = x + 1. Локальный max ≈ (−0.41; −0.83), локальный min ≈ (2.41; 4.83).',
  },
};

export function hasMatanGraph(taskId: string): boolean {
  return Boolean(MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS[taskId]);
}

const SVG_W = 640;
const SVG_H = 340;
const PAD = 36;

export function FunctionGraphCard({taskId}: FunctionGraphCardProps) {
  const spec = MATAN_GRAPH_SPECS[taskId];
  const [showAsymptotes, setShowAsymptotes] = useState(true);
  const [showExtrema, setShowExtrema] = useState(true);
  const [showInflections, setShowInflections] = useState(true);
  const [hoverX, setHoverX] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [xMin, xMax] = spec ? spec.xRange : [-5, 5];
  const [yMin, yMax] = spec ? spec.yRange : [-5, 5];

  const toSvgX = (x: number) =>
    PAD + ((x - xMin) / (xMax - xMin)) * (SVG_W - PAD * 2);
  const toSvgY = (y: number) =>
    SVG_H - PAD - ((y - yMin) / (yMax - yMin)) * (SVG_H - PAD * 2);

  const curvePaths = useMemo(() => {
    if (!spec) return [];
    const paths: string[] = [];
    const samples = 520;
    let currentD = '';
    let prevY: number | null = null;

    for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i++) {
      const x = xMin + (i / samples) * (xMax - xMin);
      const y = spec.fn(x);
      const isJump =
        prevY !== null &&
        Math.abs(y - prevY) > (yMax - yMin) * 0.45;

      if (
        !Number.isFinite(y) ||
        y < yMin - 1.2 ||
        y > yMax + 1.2 ||
        isJump
      ) {
        if (currentD) {
          paths.push(currentD);
          currentD = '';
        }
        prevY = null;
        continue;
      }

      const sx = toSvgX(x).toFixed(1);
      const sy = toSvgY(y).toFixed(1);
      currentD += currentD ? ` L ${sx} ${sy}` : `M ${sx} ${sy}`;
      prevY = y;
    }
    if (currentD) paths.push(currentD);
    return paths;
  }, [spec, xMin, xMax, yMin, yMax]);

  if (!spec) return null;

  const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent<SVGSVGElement>) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const relX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * SVG_W;
    if (relX < PAD || relX > SVG_W - PAD) {
      setHoverX(null);
      return;
    }
    const mathX = xMin + ((relX - PAD) / (SVG_W - PAD * 2)) * (xMax - xMin);
    setHoverX(mathX);
  };

  const hoverY = hoverX !== null ? spec.fn(hoverX) : Number.NaN;
  const hoverValid =
    hoverX !== null &&
    Number.isFinite(hoverY) &&
    hoverY >= yMin &&
    hoverY <= yMax;

  const xTicks: number[] = [];
  for (let x = Math.ceil(xMin); x <= Math.floor(xMax); x++) {
    if (x !== 0) xTicks.push(x);
  }
  const yTicks: number[] = [];
  for (let y = Math.ceil(yMin); y <= Math.floor(yMax); y++) {
    if (y !== 0) yTicks.push(y);
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-800/60 bg-white dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
            {spec.title}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={showAsymptotes}
              onChange={(e) => setShowAsymptotes(e.target.checked)}
              className="accent-rose-500"
            />
            <span>Асимптоты</span>
          </label>
          <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={showExtrema}
              onChange={(e) => setShowExtrema(e.target.checked)}
              className="accent-emerald-500"
            />
            <span>Экстремумы</span>
          </label>
          {spec.points.some((p) => p.kind === 'inflection') && (
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={showInflections}
                onChange={(e) => setShowInflections(e.target.checked)}
                className="accent-amber-500"
              />
              <span>Перегибы</span>
            </label>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
        <MathBlock latex={spec.latex} displayMode={false} />
        <span className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
          {hoverValid && hoverX !== null
            ? `x = ${hoverX.toFixed(2)},  f(x) = ${hoverY.toFixed(2)}`
            : 'Наведите на график для координат (x, f(x))'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="w-full overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#101010]">
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SVG_W} ${SVG_H}`}
          className="w-full h-auto block select-none"
          onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
          onMouseLeave={() => setHoverX(null)}
        >
          <defs>
            <clipPath id={`plot-clip-${taskId}`}>
              <rect
                x={PAD}
                y={PAD}
                width={SVG_W - PAD * 2}
                height={SVG_H - PAD * 2}
              />
            </clipPath>
          </defs>

          {/* Grid lines */}
          {xTicks.map((x) => (
            <line
              key={`gx-${x}`}
              x1={toSvgX(x)}
              y1={PAD}
              x2={toSvgX(x)}
              y2={SVG_H - PAD}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800"
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
          ))}
          {yTicks.map((y) => (
            <line
              key={`gy-${y}`}
              x1={PAD}
              y1={toSvgY(y)}
              x2={SVG_W - PAD}
              y2={toSvgY(y)}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800"
              strokeWidth={1}
            />
          ))}

          {/* Axes */}
          {yMin <= 0 && yMax >= 0 && (
            <line
              x1={PAD}
              y1={toSvgY(0)}
              x2={SVG_W - PAD}
              y2={toSvgY(0)}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          )}
          {xMin <= 0 && xMax >= 0 && (
            <line
              x1={toSvgX(0)}
              y1={PAD}
              x2={toSvgX(0)}
              y2={SVG_H - PAD}
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
              strokeWidth={1.5}
            />
          )}

          {/* Tick labels */}
          {xTicks.map((x) => (
            <text
              key={`tx-${x}`}
              x={toSvgX(x)}
              y={Math.min(SVG_H - PAD + 14, toSvgY(0) + 14)}
              textAnchor="middle"
              className="fill-slate-500 dark:fill-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono"
            >
              {x}
            </text>
          ))}
          {yTicks.map((y) => (
            <text
              key={`ty-${y}`}
              x={Math.max(PAD - 6, toSvgX(0) - 6)}
              y={toSvgY(y) + 3}
              textAnchor="end"
              className="fill-slate-500 dark:fill-slate-400 text-[10px] font-mono"
            >
              {y}
            </text>
          ))}

          <g clipPath={`url(#plot-clip-${taskId})`}>
            {/* Asymptotes */}
            {showAsymptotes &&
              spec.verticalAsymptotes.map((ax) => (
                <g key={`va-${ax}`}>
                  <line
                    x1={toSvgX(ax)}
                    y1={PAD}
                    x2={toSvgX(ax)}
                    y2={SVG_H - PAD}
                    stroke="#e11d48"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                    strokeDasharray="6 4"
                  />
                  <text
                    x={toSvgX(ax) + 5}
                    y={PAD + 14}
                    className="fill-rose-600 dark:fill-rose-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                  >
                    x = {ax}
                  </text>
                </g>
              ))}

            {showAsymptotes && spec.obliqueAsymptote && (
              <g>
                <line
                  x1={toSvgX(xMin)}
                  y1={toSvgY(
                    spec.obliqueAsymptote.k * xMin + spec.obliqueAsymptote.b,
                  )}
                  x2={toSvgX(xMax)}
                  y2={toSvgY(
                    spec.obliqueAsymptote.k * xMax + spec.obliqueAsymptote.b,
                  )}
                  stroke="#f97316"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                  strokeDasharray="6 4"
                />
                <text
                  x={SVG_W - PAD - 72}
                  y={PAD + 14}
                  className="fill-orange-600 dark:fill-orange-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                >
                  {spec.obliqueAsymptote.label}
                </text>
              </g>
            )}

            {/* Function curves */}
            {curvePaths.map((d, idx) => (
              <path
                key={idx}
                d={d}
                fill="none"
                stroke="#0284c7"
                strokeWidth={2.5}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              />
            ))}

            {/* Marked extrema & inflection points */}
            {spec.points.map((pt) => {
              if (pt.kind === 'extremum' && !showExtrema) return null;
              if (pt.kind === 'inflection' && !showInflections) return null;
              const cx = toSvgX(pt.x);
              const cy = toSvgY(pt.y);
              const fill = pt.kind === 'extremum' ? '#10b981' : '#f59e0b';
              return (
                <g key={pt.label}>
                  <circle
                    cx={cx}
                    cy={cy}
                    r={4.5}
                    fill={fill}
                    stroke="#ffffff"
                    strokeWidth={1.5}
                  />
                  <text
                    x={cx + 7}
                    y={cy - 7}
                    className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-slate-100 text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold"
                  >
                    {pt.label}
                  </text>
                </g>
              );
            })}

            {/* Hover crosshair */}
            {hoverValid && hoverX !== null && (
              <g>
                <line
                  x1={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  y1={PAD}
                  x2={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  y2={SVG_H - PAD}
                  stroke="#38bdf8"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  strokeDasharray="3 3"
                />
                <circle
                  cx={toSvgX(hoverX)}
                  cy={toSvgY(hoverY)}
                  r={4.5}
                  fill="#0284c7"
                  stroke="#ffffff"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                />
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>

      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
        {spec.summary}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/* Shared SVG helper shapes conforming to GOST 19.701-90 */
function SvgDefs() {
  return (
    <defs>
      <marker
        id="gost-arrow"
        viewBox="0 0 10 10"
        refX="8"
        refY="5"
        markerWidth="6"
        markerHeight="6"
        orient="auto-start-reverse"
      >
        <path d="M 0 1.5 L 8 5 L 0 8.5 z" className="fill-slate-600 dark:fill-slate-400" />
      </marker>
    </defs>
  );
}

function Terminator({x, y, text}: {x: number; y: number; text: string}) {
  return (
    <g>
      <rect
        x={x - 95}
        y={y}
        width="190"
        height="36"
        rx="18"

        className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-slate-100 text-[12px] font-medium"
      >
        {text}
      </text>
    </g>
  );
}

function IoBox({x, y, lines}: {x: number; y: number; lines: string[]}) {
  const h = lines.length > 1 ? 46 : 38;
  const pts = `${x - 105},${y} ${x + 120},${y} ${x + 105},${y + h} ${x - 120},${y + h}`;

        >

      ))}

}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  ExternalLink,
  GitBranch,
  History,
  Layers,
  Route,
  Sparkles,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  buildComputedSkillGraph,
  collectPrerequisiteTopics,
  ComputedSkillNode,
  computeDominoImpact,
  findHighestDominoRiskNode,
} from '../data/knowledgeGraphData';
import {CardSRState, StudyCategory, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {
  getCardMasteryPercent,
  getCardSRState,
  getCardVisualTier,
} from '../utils/spacedRepetition';

export type PreviousTopicsMode = 'current' | 'direct' | 'all_ancestors';

interface KnowledgeGraphModalProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  subjectTitle: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  srMap: Record<number, CardSRState>;
  onJumpToCard: (cardId: number) => void;
  onOpenTopicInDeck: (
    label: string,
    cardIds: number[],
    startCardId?: number,
  ) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const TIER_LABELS = [
  'Уровень 1 · Фундамент',
  'Уровень 2 · Опорные теоремы',
  'Уровень 3 · Основной аппарат',
  'Уровень 4 · Билеты-боссы',
];

export function KnowledgeGraphModal({
  category,
  subjectTitle,
  allCards,
  srMap,
  onJumpToCard,
  onOpenTopicInDeck,
  onClose,
}: KnowledgeGraphModalProps) {
  const nodes = useMemo(
    () => buildComputedSkillGraph(category, allCards, srMap),
    [category, allCards, srMap],
  );

  const highestRiskNode = useMemo(() => findHighestDominoRiskNode(nodes), [nodes]);
  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState<string>(
    () => highestRiskNode?.id ?? nodes[0]?.id ?? '',
  );
  const [dominoMode, setDominoMode] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [prevMode, setPrevMode] = useState<PreviousTopicsMode>('current');
  const [onlyUnlearned, setOnlyUnlearned] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [autoJumpOnClick, setAutoJumpOnClick] = useState<boolean>(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!nodes.some((n) => n.id === selectedNodeId)) {
      setSelectedNodeId(highestRiskNode?.id ?? nodes[0]?.id ?? '');
    }
  }, [nodes, selectedNodeId, highestRiskNode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const byId = useMemo(() => new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), [nodes]);
  const cardsById = useMemo(
    () => new Map(allCards.map((c) => [c.id, c])),
    [allCards],
  );
  const selectedNode: ComputedSkillNode | null = byId.get(selectedNodeId) ?? null;

  const dominoReport = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedNodeId) return null;
    return computeDominoImpact(nodes, selectedNodeId);
  }, [nodes, selectedNodeId]);

  const prereqInfo = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedNodeId) {
      return {
        directPrereqIds: [],
        allAncestorIds: [],
        directEdgeKeys: [],
        allAncestorEdgeKeys: [],
      };
    }
    return collectPrerequisiteTopics(nodes, selectedNodeId);
  }, [nodes, selectedNodeId]);

  const includedPrereqIds = useMemo(() => {
    if (prevMode === 'direct') return prereqInfo.directPrereqIds;
    if (prevMode === 'all_ancestors') return prereqInfo.allAncestorIds;
    return [];
  }, [prevMode, prereqInfo]);

  const includedPrereqSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set(includedPrereqIds),
    [includedPrereqIds],
  );
  const includedPrereqEdgeSet = useMemo(() => {
    if (prevMode === 'direct') return new Set(prereqInfo.directEdgeKeys);
    if (prevMode === 'all_ancestors') return new Set(prereqInfo.allAncestorEdgeKeys);
    return new Set<string>();
  }, [prevMode, prereqInfo]);

  const affectedNodeSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set(dominoReport?.affectedNodeIds ?? []),
    [dominoReport],
  );
  const affectedEdgeSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set(dominoReport?.affectedEdgeKeys ?? []),
    [dominoReport],
  );
  const repairPathSet = useMemo(
    () => new Set(dominoReport?.repairPathNodeIds ?? []),
    [dominoReport],
  );

  const edges = useMemo(() => {
    const list: {from: ComputedSkillNode; to: ComputedSkillNode; key: string}[] = [];
    for (const node of nodes) {
      for (const prereqId of node.prereqs) {
        const from = byId.get(prereqId);
        if (from) {
          list.push({from, to: node, key: `${from.id}->${node.id}`});
        }
      }
    }
    return list;
  }, [nodes, byId]);

  // Build grouped cards: selected topic FIRST (for instant visibility!), then previous topics if toggled
  const cardGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedNode) return [];
    const seenCardIds = new Set<number>();

    const buildGroup = (
      node: ComputedSkillNode,
      isPrevious: boolean,
    ): {node: ComputedSkillNode; isPrevious: boolean; cards: TheoryCard[]} | null => {
      const list: TheoryCard[] = [];
      for (const id of node.cardIds) {
        if (seenCardIds.has(id)) continue;
        const card = cardsById.get(id);
        if (!card) continue;
        if (onlyUnlearned) {
          const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, id);
          if (sr.status === 'known') continue;
        }
        seenCardIds.add(id);
        list.push(card);
      }
      if (list.length === 0) return null;
      return {node, isPrevious, cards: list};
    };

    const groups: {node: ComputedSkillNode; isPrevious: boolean; cards: TheoryCard[]}[] = [];

    // Current selected topic first so its cards appear right away
    const mainGroup = buildGroup(selectedNode, false);
    if (mainGroup) groups.push(mainGroup);

    // Then previous prerequisite topics (most direct first or foundation->direct)
    for (const pid of includedPrereqIds) {
      const pNode = byId.get(pid);
      if (!pNode) continue;
      const g = buildGroup(pNode, true);
      if (g) groups.push(g);
    }

    return groups;
  }, [selectedNode, includedPrereqIds, byId, cardsById, onlyUnlearned, srMap]);

  const combinedCardIds = useMemo(
    () => cardGroups.flatMap((g) => g.cards.map((c) => c.id)),
    [cardGroups],
  );

  const selectionLabel = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedNode) return '';
    if (prevMode === 'direct' && prereqInfo.directPrereqIds.length > 0) {
      return `${selectedNode.shortLabel} + прямая база`;
    }
    if (prevMode === 'all_ancestors' && prereqInfo.allAncestorIds.length > 0) {
      return `${selectedNode.shortLabel} + все прошлые темы`;
    }
    return selectedNode.shortLabel;
  }, [selectedNode, prevMode, prereqInfo]);

  const buildNodeSelectionForJump = (
    node: ComputedSkillNode,
    mode: PreviousTopicsMode,
  ): {label: string; cardIds: number[]; startCardId?: number} => {
    const pInfo = collectPrerequisiteTopics(nodes, node.id);
    const extraNodeIds =
      mode === 'direct'
        ? pInfo.directPrereqIds
        : mode === 'all_ancestors'
          ? pInfo.allAncestorIds
          : [];

    const idSet = new Set<number>();
    const orderedIds: number[] = [];

    // If studying with previous topics, put previous foundation cards first OR selected topic first?
    // Put selected topic cards + previous topics without duplicates, start on first unlearned card
    const sourceNodes = [
      node,
      ...extraNodeIds
        .map((id) => byId.get(id))
        .filter((n): n is ComputedSkillNode => Boolean(n)),
    ];

    for (const sn of sourceNodes) {
      for (const cid of sn.cardIds) {
        if (idSet.has(cid)) continue;
        if (onlyUnlearned && getCardSRState(srMap, cid).status === 'known') {
          continue;
        }
        idSet.add(cid);
        orderedIds.push(cid);
      }
    }

    // Fallback if onlyUnlearned filtered everything out
    const finalIds = orderedIds.length > 0 ? orderedIds : node.cardIds;
    const firstWeak = finalIds.find(
      (cid) => getCardSRState(srMap, cid).status !== 'known',
    );
    const label =
      mode === 'direct' && pInfo.directPrereqIds.length > 0
        ? `${node.shortLabel} + прямая база`
        : mode === 'all_ancestors' && pInfo.allAncestorIds.length > 0
          ? `${node.shortLabel} + все прошлые темы`
          : node.shortLabel;

    return {
      label,
      cardIds: finalIds,
      startCardId: firstWeak ?? finalIds[0],
    };
  };

  const handleNodeClick = (node: ComputedSkillNode) => {
    setSelectedNodeId(node.id);
    if (autoJumpOnClick) {
      const payload = buildNodeSelectionForJump(node, prevMode);
      if (payload.cardIds.length > 0) {
        onOpenTopicInDeck(payload.label, payload.cardIds, payload.startCardId);
        onClose();
      }
    }
  };

  const handleTransferToDeck = (specificCardId?: number) => {
    if (!selectedNode) return;
    const ids =
      combinedCardIds.length > 0 ? combinedCardIds : selectedNode.cardIds;
    if (ids.length === 0) return;
    const firstWeak = ids.find(
      (cid) => getCardSRState(srMap, cid).status !== 'known',
    );
    onOpenTopicInDeck(
      selectionLabel,
      ids,
      specificCardId ?? firstWeak ?? ids[0],
    );
    onClose();
  };

  const overallStats = useMemo(() => {
    let mastered = 0;
    let shaky = 0;
    let critical = 0;
    for (const n of nodes) {
      if (n.status === 'mastered') mastered++;
      else if (n.status === 'shaky') shaky++;
      else critical++;
    }
    return {mastered, shaky, critical};
  }, [nodes]);

  const isSelectedWeak = selectedNode && selectedNode.status !== 'mastered';
  const hasPrereqs = prereqInfo.allAncestorIds.length > 0;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Дерево навыков и эффект домино"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-2 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="w-full max-w-6xl rounded-[20px] prism-surface shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto flex flex-col max-h-[94vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#0B101B]/85 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/25 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <GitBranch className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] truncate">
                Дерево навыков · {subjectTitle}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] truncate">
                Кликни по теме — сразу увидишь её карточки, прошлые темы-базы и перенос в раздел
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            {/* Optional 1-click Auto-Teleport toggle */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAutoJumpOnClick((v) => !v)}
              title="Если включено, клик по любому узлу сразу переносит тебя в раздел карточек по этой теме"
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                autoJumpOnClick
                  ? 'prism-tab-active text-slate-900 dark:text-white'
                  : 'prism-tool-btn text-slate-600 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]'
              }`}
            >
              <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-500 dark:text-cyan-400" />
              <span>При клике: {autoJumpOnClick ? 'сразу в раздел' : 'превью'}</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setDominoMode((v) => !v)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                dominoMode
                  ? 'border-rose-500/60 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-200'
                  : 'prism-tool-btn text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]'
              }`}
            >
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Домино: {dominoMode ? 'ВКЛ' : 'ВЫКЛ'}</span>
            </button>

            {highestRiskNode && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedNodeId(highestRiskNode.id);
                  setDominoMode(true);
                }}
                className="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full prism-cta cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-lime-300" />
                <span>Главный пробел</span>
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Закрыть"
              className="p-2 rounded-full text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:text-white dark:hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Split: Left SVG Skill Tree + Right Instant Cards & Inspector */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-h-0 grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_390px] overflow-hidden">
          {/* Interactive SVG DAG Canvas */}
          <div className="relative bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#070B12] overflow-auto p-3 sm:p-4 flex flex-col">
            {/* Legend Bar */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                  Освоено ({overallStats.mastered})
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                  Шатко ({overallStats.shaky})
                </span>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500" />
                  Пробел ({overallStats.critical})
                </span>
                {prevMode !== 'current' && includedPrereqIds.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400 font-semibold">
                    <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-violet-500" />
                    Прошлые темы (+{includedPrereqIds.length})
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <Layers className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Стрелки: «опирается на»
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 min-h-[430px] flex items-center justify-center">
              <svg
                viewBox="0 0 1000 620"
                className="w-full h-full max-h-[600px] select-none"
                role="img"
                aria-label="Интерактивный граф зависимостей тем предмета"
              >
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="dt-selected-grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#d9f99d" />
                    <stop offset="48%" stopColor="#34d399" />
                    <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#22d3ee" />
                  </linearGradient>
                  <marker
                    id="arrow-neutral"
                    viewBox="0 0 10 10"
                    refX="8"
                    refY="5"
                    markerWidth="6"
                    markerHeight="6"
                    orient="auto-start-reverse"
                  >
                    <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#64748b" opacity="0.55" />
                  </marker>
                  <marker
                    id="arrow-domino"
                    viewBox="0 0 10 10"
                    refX="8"
                    refY="5"
                    markerWidth="7"
                    markerHeight="7"
                    orient="auto-start-reverse"
                  >
                    <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#f43f5e" />
                  </marker>
                  <marker
                    id="arrow-repair"
                    viewBox="0 0 10 10"
                    refX="8"
                    refY="5"
                    markerWidth="7"
                    markerHeight="7"
                    orient="auto-start-reverse"
                  >
                    <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#22d3ee" />
                  </marker>
                  <marker
                    id="arrow-prereq"
                    viewBox="0 0 10 10"
                    refX="8"
                    refY="5"
                    markerWidth="7"
                    markerHeight="7"
                    orient="auto-start-reverse"
                  >
                    <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#a78bfa" />
                  </marker>
                </defs>

                {/* Subtle Tier Guide Lines */}
                {[85, 236, 388, 540].map((yPos, tIdx) => (
                  <g key={tIdx}>
                    <line
                      x1="28"
                      y1={yPos}
                      x2="972"
                      y2={yPos}
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      className="text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-800/70"
                      strokeDasharray="4 6"
                      strokeWidth="1"
                    />
                    <text
                      x="32"
                      y={yPos - 40}
                      className="fill-slate-400 dark:fill-slate-500 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase"
                    >
                      {TIER_LABELS[tIdx] ?? ''}
                    </text>
                  </g>
                ))}

                {/* Dependency Curved Edges */}
                {edges.map(({from, to, key}) => {
                  const isDominoEdge =
                    dominoMode && isSelectedWeak && affectedEdgeSet.has(key);
                  const isPrereqEdge = includedPrereqEdgeSet.has(key);
                  const isRepairEdge =
                    repairPathSet.has(from.id) && repairPathSet.has(to.id);

                  const startY = from.y + 30;
                  const endY = to.y - 32;
                  const midY = (startY + endY) / 2;
                  const pathD = `M ${from.x} ${startY} C ${from.x} ${midY}, ${to.x} ${midY}, ${to.x} ${endY}`;

                  return (
                    <path
                      key={key}
                      d={pathD}
                      fill="none"
                      stroke={
                        isDominoEdge
                          ? '#f43f5e'
                          : isPrereqEdge
                            ? '#8b5cf6'
                            : isRepairEdge
                              ? '#38bdf8'
                              : '#64748b'
                      }
                      strokeWidth={
                        isDominoEdge
                          ? 3.2
                          : isPrereqEdge
                            ? 2.8
                            : isRepairEdge
                              ? 2.4
                              : 1.5
                      }
                      strokeOpacity={
                        isDominoEdge
                          ? 0.95
                          : isPrereqEdge
                            ? 0.9
                            : isRepairEdge
                              ? 0.8
                              : 0.35
                      }
                      strokeDasharray={isDominoEdge ? '8 4' : undefined}
                      markerEnd={
                        isDominoEdge
                          ? 'url(#arrow-domino)'
                          : isPrereqEdge
                            ? 'url(#arrow-prereq)'
                            : isRepairEdge
                              ? 'url(#arrow-repair)'
                              : 'url(#arrow-neutral)'
                      }
                    >
                      {isDominoEdge && (
                        <animate
                          attributeName="stroke-dashoffset"
                          from="24"
                          to="0"
                          dur="1s"
                          repeatCount="indefinite"
                        />
                      )}
                    </path>
                  );
                })}

                {/* Skill Nodes */}
                {nodes.map((node) => {
                  const isSelected = node.id === selectedNodeId;
                  const isDominoVictim =
                    dominoMode && isSelectedWeak && affectedNodeSet.has(node.id);
                  const isIncludedPrereq = includedPrereqSet.has(node.id);
                  const isOnRepair = repairPathSet.has(node.id);

                  const borderColor =
                    node.status === 'mastered'
                      ? '#10b981'
                      : node.status === 'shaky'
                        ? '#f59e0b'
                        : '#f43f5e';

                  const nodeWidth = 178;
                  const nodeHeight = 60;

                  return (
                    <g
                      key={node.id}
                      transform={`translate(${node.x - nodeWidth / 2}, ${node.y - nodeHeight / 2})`}
                      onClick={() => handleNodeClick(node)}
                      className="cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {/* Outer Glow for Selected, Domino Cascade, or Included Previous Topic */}
                      {(isSelected || isDominoVictim || isIncludedPrereq) && (
                        <rect
                          x="-5"
                          y="-5"
                          width={nodeWidth + 10}
                          height={nodeHeight + 10}
                          rx="16"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke={
                            isSelected
                              ? 'url(#dt-selected-grad)'
                              : isDominoVictim
                                ? '#f43f5e'
                                : '#a78bfa'
                          }
                          strokeWidth={isSelected ? 2.5 : 1.75}
                          strokeOpacity={isSelected ? 0.95 : 0.78}
                          strokeDasharray={
                            !isSelected && isDominoVictim ? '5 4' : undefined
                          }
                        />
                      )}

                      {/* Node Card */}
                      <rect
                        width={nodeWidth}
                        height={nodeHeight}
                        rx="14"
                        className="fill-white dark:fill-[#0E1522]"
                        stroke={borderColor}
                        strokeWidth={isSelected ? 2 : 1.5}
                      />

                      {/* Mastery Fill Strip at Bottom */}
                      <rect
                        x="10"
                        y={nodeHeight - 10}
                        width={nodeWidth - 20}
                        height="4"
                        rx="2"
                        className="fill-slate-200 dark:fill-[#1A2438]"
                      />
                      <rect
                        x="10"
                        y={nodeHeight - 10}
                        width={Math.max(
                          6,
                          ((nodeWidth - 20) * node.masteryPct) / 100,
                        )}
                        height="4"
                        rx="2"
                        fill={
                          node.masteryPct >= 95
                            ? 'url(#dt-selected-grad)'
                            : borderColor
                        }
                      />

                      {/* Node Label */}
                      <text
                        x="12"
                        y="22"
                        className="fill-slate-900 dark:fill-[#F3F4F6] text-[12px] font-bold"
                      >
                        {node.shortLabel}
                      </text>

                      {/* Cards Count & Mastery % */}
                      <text
                        x="12"
                        y="40"
                        className="fill-slate-500 dark:fill-[#9CA3AF] text-[10.5px] font-mono"
                      >
                        {node.knownCards}/{node.totalCards} карт. · {node.masteryPct}%
                      </text>

                      {/* Tags */}
                      {isDominoVictim && (
                        <g transform={`translate(${nodeWidth - 54}, -9)`}>
                          <rect width="52" height="16" rx="5" fill="#f43f5e" />
                          <text
                            x="26"
                            y="11"
                            textAnchor="middle"
                            className="fill-white text-[9px] font-bold"
                          >
                            РУХНЕТ
                          </text>
                        </g>
                      )}

                      {!isDominoVictim && isIncludedPrereq && !isSelected && (
                        <g transform={`translate(${nodeWidth - 62}, -9)`}>
                          <rect width="60" height="16" rx="5" fill="#7c3aed" />
                          <text
                            x="30"
                            y="11"
                            textAnchor="middle"
                            className="fill-white text-[9px] font-bold"
                          >
                            ПРОШЛАЯ
                          </text>
                        </g>
                      )}

                      {!isDominoVictim &&
                        !isIncludedPrereq &&
                        isOnRepair &&
                        !isSelected && (
                          <g transform={`translate(${nodeWidth - 62}, -9)`}>
                            <rect width="60" height="16" rx="5" fill="#0284c7" />
                            <text
                              x="30"
                              y="11"
                              textAnchor="middle"
                              className="fill-white text-[9px] font-bold"
                            >
                              ПОЧИНИТЬ
                            </text>
                          </g>
                        )}
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </svg>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Sidebar: Instant Topic Cards + Previous Topics Toggle + Transfer to Section + Domino */}
          <aside className="border-t lg:border-t-0 lg:border-l border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] p-4 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
            {selectedNode && dominoReport && (
              <>
                {/* Selected Node Summary + Instant Transfer CTA */}
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span
                      className={`text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${
                        selectedNode.masteryPct >= 95
                          ? 'rainbow-mastered-badge'
                          : selectedNode.status === 'mastered'
                            ? 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300'
                            : selectedNode.status === 'shaky'
                              ? 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                              : 'border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {selectedNode.masteryPct >= 95
                        ? 'Мастерство'
                        : selectedNode.status === 'mastered'
                          ? 'Освоено'
                          : selectedNode.status === 'shaky'
                            ? 'Шаткий узел'
                            : 'Критический пробел'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {selectedNode.masteryPct}%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                    {selectedNode.label}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                    {selectedNode.description}
                  </p>

                  {/* Primary Action: Transfer into Flashcards Section filtered to this selection */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleTransferToDeck()}
                    disabled={combinedCardIds.length === 0 && selectedNode.cardIds.length === 0}
                    className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full prism-cta disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-300" />
                    <span>
                      Перейти в раздел карточек (
                      {combinedCardIds.length > 0
                        ? combinedCardIds.length
                        : selectedNode.cardIds.length}{' '}
                      шт.)
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Instant Cards Section with Previous Topics Switcher */}
                <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] p-3.5 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                      <History className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
                      Карточки темы ({combinedCardIds.length})
                    </span>
                    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8] cursor-pointer select-none">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={onlyUnlearned}
                        onChange={(e) => setOnlyUnlearned(e.target.checked)}
                        className="rounded border-slate-300 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                      <span>Только невыученные</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  {/* Optional Previous Topics Inclusion Switcher */}
                  {hasPrereqs && (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 p-1 rounded-full bg-slate-200/70 dark:bg-[#131B2B] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.06]">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPrevMode('current')}
                        className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          prevMode === 'current'
                            ? 'prism-tab-active text-slate-950 dark:text-white'
                            : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Эта тема
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPrevMode('direct')}
                        className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          prevMode === 'direct'
                            ? 'bg-violet-500/20 border border-violet-400/50 text-violet-800 dark:text-violet-200'
                            : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        + Прошлая ({prereqInfo.directPrereqIds.length})
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPrevMode('all_ancestors')}
                        className={`px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          prevMode === 'all_ancestors'

                    {(() => {
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Maximize2} from 'lucide-react';
import {LECTURES, LECTURE_MAP} from '../data';
import {LectureId, StudyCategory} from '../types/study';
import {SlideCanvas} from './SlideCanvas';
import {SlideModal} from './SlideModal';

interface LecturesLibraryProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
}

export function LecturesLibrary({category}: LecturesLibraryProps) {
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<LectureId>(
    category === 'rk'
      ? 'rk2_angeom'
      : category === 'matan'
        ? 'matan_theory'
        : 'lec1',
  );
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [modalOpen, setModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedId(
      category === 'rk'
        ? 'rk2_angeom'
        : category === 'matan'
          ? 'matan_theory'
          : 'lec1',
    );
    setPage(1);
  }, [category]);

  const visibleLectures =
    category === 'rk'
      ? LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category === 'rk')
      : category === 'matan'
        ? LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category === 'matan')
        : LECTURES.filter((l) => l.category !== 'rk' && l.category !== 'matan');

  if (category.startsWith('custom_')) {
    return (
      <section className="prism-surface rounded-2xl p-8 text-center space-y-2">
        <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
          Карточки этого предмета уже извлечены из вашего PDF
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
          Исходный локальный PDF-файл обрабатывается прямо в браузере и не загружается на сервер. В каждой карточке в подсказке указан номер исходной страницы.
        </p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const activeLecture = LECTURE_MAP[selectedId] ?? visibleLectures[0];

  const handleSelectLecture = (id: LectureId) => {
    setSelectedId(id);
    setPage(1);
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start">
      {/* Left Column: Lecture Catalog */}
      <aside className="lg:col-span-4 prism-surface rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2">
        <div className="px-1 pb-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
            {category === 'rk'
              ? 'PDF-документ Рубежного контроля №2'
              : category === 'matan'
                ? 'PDF-документы Экзамена по Матану'
                : 'Исходные PDF-материалы курса АИП'}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] mt-0.5 tabular-nums">
            {category === 'rk'
              ? 'Ангем РК 2 · 4 страницы (теория, задачи, типовой билет)'
              : category === 'matan'
                ? `${visibleLectures.length} PDF-документов · ${visibleLectures.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.pageCount, 0)} стр.: теория, задачи G22 и 3 методички МГТУ Ч.1–3`
                : `${visibleLectures.length} документов · перечень и 8 лекций`}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {visibleLectures.map((doc) => {
            const isActive = doc.id === activeLecture.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={doc.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSelectLecture(doc.id)}
                className={`w-full text-left rounded-lg border p-3 transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-sky-50 border-sky-300 dark:bg-sky-500/15 dark:border-sky-500/50'
                    : 'bg-slate-50/70 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 dark:bg-[#0B101B] dark:border-white/[0.08] dark:hover:border-[#404040]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                    {doc.shortTitle}
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] tabular-nums">
                    {doc.pageCount} стр.
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] leading-snug">
                  {doc.title}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                  {doc.chapterLabel} · {doc.dateLabel}
                </p>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Right Column: Slide Browser */}
      <section className="lg:col-span-8 prism-surface rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08]">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
              {activeLecture.shortTitle} · {activeLecture.chapterLabel}
            </p>
            <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] truncate">
              {activeLecture.title}
            </h3>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={page <= 1}
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              aria-label="Предыдущий слайд"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={activeLecture.pageCount}
                value={page}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const val = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
                  if (!Number.isNaN(val)) {
                    setPage(Math.max(1, Math.min(val, activeLecture.pageCount)));
                  }
                }}
                aria-label="Номер страницы лекции"
                className="w-14 px-2 py-1.5 text-center rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B101B] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"
              />
              <span>/ {activeLecture.pageCount}</span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={page >= activeLecture.pageCount}
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(activeLecture.pageCount, p + 1))}
              className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
              aria-label="Следующий слайд"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModalOpen(true)}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg prism-cta transition-colors whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Maximize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>На весь экран</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4">
          <SlideCanvas lectureId={selectedId} page={page} maxWidth={960} />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
          {activeLecture.topics.map((topic, idx) => (
            <span key={idx}>
              {idx > 0 && <span className="mr-4" aria-hidden="true">·</span>}
              {topic}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {modalOpen && (
        <SlideModal
          lectureId={selectedId}
          initialPage={page}
          title={activeLecture.title}
          onClose={() => setModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useMemo} from 'react';
import katex from 'katex';

interface MathBlockProps {
  latex: string;
  displayMode?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Renders genuine LaTeX mathematical expressions (2D matrices, determinants,
 * curly-brace systems of equations, fractions, indices) like a real textbook.
 */
export function MathBlock({
  latex,
  displayMode = true,
  className = '',
}: MathBlockProps) {
  const html = useMemo(() => {
    try {
      return katex.renderToString(latex, {
        displayMode,
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true,
      });
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  }, [latex, displayMode]);

  if (!html) {
    return (
      <div className={`font-serif text-sm ${className}`}>
        {latex}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div
      className={`overflow-x-auto py-1 text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] ${className}`}
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: html}}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {FormEvent, useEffect, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  Award,
  Flag,
  GraduationCap,
  Loader2,
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  RefreshCw,
  Send,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {RecallGrade, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {
  HybridVoiceRecorderHandle,
  speakRussianText,
  startHybridVoiceRecording,
  stopSpeaking,
} from '../utils/speechAndGrading';
import {MathBlock} from './MathBlock';

interface OralExamDialogModalProps {
  initialCard: TheoryCard;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  onRateCard: (cardId: number, grade: RecallGrade) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface DialogTurn {
  role: 'professor' | 'student';
  text: string;
}

interface OralTurnResponse {
  isFinished: boolean;
  professorMessage: string;
  examGrade: number | null;
  scorePct: number;
  recommendedGrade: RecallGrade;
  feedbackSummary: string;
}

export function OralExamDialogModal({
  initialCard,
  allCards,
  onRateCard,
  onClose,
}: OralExamDialogModalProps) {
  const [card, setCard] = useState<TheoryCard>(initialCard);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<DialogTurn[]>([
    {
      role: 'professor',
      text: `Здравствуйте! Ваш билет №${initialCard.id}: «${initialCard.question}». Расскажите своими словами ключевую суть, формулировку и главные шаги.`,
    },
  ]);
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [isTranscribing, setIsTranscribing] = useState(false);
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
  const [autoSpeak, setAutoSpeak] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [finalOutcome, setFinalOutcome] = useState<{
    examGrade: number;
    scorePct: number;
    recommendedGrade: RecallGrade;
    feedbackSummary: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const recorderRef = useRef<HybridVoiceRecorderHandle | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const studentTurns = history.filter((h) => h.role === 'student').length;

  useEffect(() => {
    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({
      top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight,
      behavior: 'smooth',
    });
  }, [history, isSending]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoSpeak && history.length === 1) {
      speakRussianText(history[0].text);
    }
    return () => {
      stopSpeaking();
      void recorderRef.current?.stop();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [card.id]);

  const stopRecordingIfActive = async (): Promise<string> => {
    const handle = recorderRef.current;
    recorderRef.current = null;
    setIsRecording(false);
    if (!handle) return inputText;
    try {
      return await handle.stop();
    } catch {
      return inputText;
    }
  };

  const handleToggleMic = async () => {
    if (isRecording) {
      const txt = await stopRecordingIfActive();
      setInputText(txt);
      return;
    }
    stopSpeaking();
    setError('');
    const handle = await startHybridVoiceRecording({
      initialText: inputText,
      questionContext: card.question,
      onLiveText: (t) => setInputText(t),
      onTranscribingChange: (flag) => setIsTranscribing(flag),
      onError: (msg) => setError(msg),
      onStop: () => setIsRecording(false),
    });
    if (handle) {
      recorderRef.current = handle;
      setIsRecording(true);
    }
  };

  const sendTurnToProfessor = async (finishNow = false) => {
    if (isSending || finalOutcome) return;
    stopSpeaking();

    let answerText = inputText.trim();
    if (isRecording) {
      answerText = (await stopRecordingIfActive()).trim();
    }

    let nextHistory = [...history];
    if (answerText) {
      nextHistory.push({role: 'student', text: answerText});
      setHistory(nextHistory);
      setInputText('');
    } else if (!finishNow) {
      setError('Скажите или напишите свой ответ перед отправкой.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSending(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/oral-turn', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          card: {
            question: card.question,
            chapter: card.chapter,
            keyThesis: card.keyThesis,
            answerPoints: card.answerPoints,
            examTip: card.examTip,
          },
          history: nextHistory,
          finishNow,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось получить ответ преподавателя');
      }
      const data = (await res.json()) as OralTurnResponse;
      const updated = [
        ...nextHistory,
        {role: 'professor' as const, text: data.professorMessage},
      ];
      setHistory(updated);

      if (autoSpeak) {
        speakRussianText(data.professorMessage);
      }

      if (data.isFinished) {
        const grade = data.examGrade ?? 3;
        setFinalOutcome({
          examGrade: grade,
          scorePct: data.scorePct,
          recommendedGrade: data.recommendedGrade,
          feedbackSummary: data.feedbackSummary,
        });
        onRateCard(card.id, data.recommendedGrade);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Ошибка связи с преподавателем');
    } finally {
      setIsSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    void sendTurnToProfessor(false);
  };

  const handlePickNextTicket = () => {
    stopSpeaking();
    void stopRecordingIfActive();
    const pool = allCards.filter((c) => c.id !== card.id);
    const next =
      pool.length > 0
        ? pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]
        : card;
    setCard(next);
    setHistory([
      {
        role: 'professor',
        text: `Следующий билет №${next.id}: «${next.question}». Слушаю ваш ответ!`,
      },
    ]);
    setInputText('');
    setFinalOutcome(null);
    setError('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="no-print fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-2 sm:p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <GraduationCap className="h-5 w-5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] truncate">
                Устный экзамен до конца · Билет №{card.id}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] truncate">
                {card.chapter} · Раунд {Math.min(3, studentTurns + 1)} из 3
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (autoSpeak) stopSpeaking();
                setAutoSpeak((s) => !s);
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
            >

            <button

              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"

                >

                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Input Composer */}
        {!finalOutcome && (
          <form
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
            className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-[#0B101B] space-y-2.5"

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
              <textarea
                rows={2}

                value={inputText}
                onChange={(e) => setInputText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  isRecording
                    ? 'Говорите в микрофон — ваш ответ записывается...'
                    : isTranscribing
                      ? 'Расшифровка речи...'
                      : 'Ответьте голосом (кнопка микрофона) или введите текст...'

                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  disabled={isSending || isTranscribing}
                  onClick={() => void handleToggleMic()}
                  className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 ${
                    isRecording
                      ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500'
                      : 'prism-cta'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isRecording ? (
                    <>
                      <MicOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Стоп записи</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Mic className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />

                    </>
                  )}
                </button>

                {studentTurns > 0 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={isSending}
                    onClick={() => void sendTurnToProfessor(true)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    <Flag className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>Завершить и получить оценку</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSending || isTranscribing}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-emerald-500 dark:text-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-emerald-400 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Отправить ответ</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useState} from 'react';
import {Download, MonitorSmartphone, X} from 'lucide-react';
import {usePWAInstall} from '../hooks/usePWAInstall';

export function PWAInstallButton() {
  const {isInstallable, isInstalled, isIOS, install} = usePWAInstall();
  const [showGuide, setShowGuide] = useState(false);

  if (isInstalled) {
    return null;
  }

  if (isInstallable) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => void install()}
        className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
        title="Установить как отдельное приложение на ПК или телефон (работает офлайн)"
      >
        <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
        <span className="hidden 2xl:inline">Установить</span>
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setShowGuide(true)}
        className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
        title="Как установить приложение на рабочий стол ПК или экран телефона"
      >
        <MonitorSmartphone className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
        <span className="hidden 2xl:inline">На экран</span>
      </button>

      {showGuide && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xs p-4"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Установка приложения на ПК или телефон"
          onClick={() => setShowGuide(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] p-5 shadow-2xl space-y-4"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                Установка как отдельная программа (PWA)
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGuide(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-[#94A3B8] dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Закрыть"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {isIOS ? (
              <ol className="space-y-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] list-decimal pl-5">
                <li>
                  Откройте приложение напрямую в <strong>Safari</strong>.
                </li>
                <li>
                  Нажмите кнопку <strong>Поделиться</strong> (квадрат со стрелкой вверх) на нижней панели.
                </li>
                <li>
                  Выберите пункт <strong>«На экран «Домой»»</strong> и нажмите <strong>Добавить</strong>.
                </li>
              </ol>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                <p>
                  Приложение поддерживает установку в отдельное окно (как <span className="font-mono">.exe</span>, без адресной строки браузера) и офлайн-работу с карточками и PDF:
                </p>
                <ol className="space-y-1.5 list-decimal pl-5">
                  <li>
                    Откройте ссылку приложения в новой вкладке <strong>Chrome</strong> или <strong>Microsoft Edge</strong>.
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    Нажмите значок <strong>«Установить приложение»</strong> в правой части адресной строки (или меню ⋮ → <em>Сохранить и поделиться → Установить страницу как приложение</em>).
                  </li>
                  <li>
                    Ярлык появится на рабочем столе Windows / в меню «Пуск».
                  </li>
                </ol>
              </div>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowGuide(false)}
              className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg prism-cta cursor-pointer"
            >
              Понятно
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
