```tsx
import {useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Flame,
  Loader2,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldAlert,
  Sparkles,
  Trophy,
  X,
  XCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  getCuratedRoundsForCategory,
  SpotTheLieRound,
} from '../data/spotTheLieData';
import {StudyCategory, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {MathBlock} from './MathBlock';

interface SpotTheLieModalProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  subjectTitle: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  onOpenCardInDeck?: (cardId: number) => void;
  onCorrectRound?: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const ROUND_SECONDS = 30;
const SESSION_TARGET = 10;

function shuffle<T>(arr: T[]): T[] {
  const copy = [...arr];
  for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [copy[i], copy[j]] = [copy[j], copy[i]];
  }
  return copy;
}

export function SpotTheLieModal({
  category,
  subjectTitle,
  allCards,
  onOpenCardInDeck,
  onCorrectRound,
  onClose,
}: SpotTheLieModalProps) {
  const initialPool = useMemo(
    () => shuffle(getCuratedRoundsForCategory(category)),
    [category],
  );

  const [rounds, setRounds] = useState<SpotTheLieRound[]>(initialPool);
  const [roundIdx, setRoundIdx] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeftMs, setTimeLeftMs] = useState(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
  const [selectedStepIdx, setSelectedStepIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false);

  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [played, setPlayed] = useState(0);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);
  const [bestStreak, setBestStreak] = useState(0);
  const [reactionTimesSec, setReactionTimesSec] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [sessionDone, setSessionDone] = useState(false);

  const [isGeneratingAi, setIsGeneratingAi] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState('');

  const timerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const currentRound = rounds[roundIdx] ?? null;
  const isResolved = selectedStepIdx !== null || timedOut;

  // Countdown timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentRound || isResolved || sessionDone || isGeneratingAi) {
      if (timerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
      return;
    }

    const startedAt = Date.now();
    const initialRemaining = timeLeftMs;

    timerRef.current = window.setInterval(() => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
      const next = Math.max(0, initialRemaining - elapsed);
      setTimeLeftMs(next);
      if (next <= 0) {
        if (timerRef.current !== null) {
          window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
          timerRef.current = null;
        }
        setTimedOut(true);
        setPlayed((p) => p + 1);
        setStreak(0);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [roundIdx, isResolved, sessionDone, isGeneratingAi, currentRound?.id]);

  // Escape key closes modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleSelectStep = (idx: number) => {
    if (!currentRound || isResolved) return;
    const elapsedSec = Math.max(
      0.4,
      Number(((ROUND_SECONDS * 1000 - timeLeftMs) / 1000).toFixed(1)),
    );
    setSelectedStepIdx(idx);
    setPlayed((p) => p + 1);

    if (idx === currentRound.poisonedIndex) {
      setScore((s) => s + 1);
      onCorrectRound?.();
      setReactionTimesSec((prev) => [...prev, elapsedSec]);
      setStreak((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        setBestStreak((b) => Math.max(b, next));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setStreak(0);
    }
  };

  const generateAiRound = useCallback(async () => {
    if (allCards.length === 0) return;
    setIsGeneratingAi(true);
    setAiError('');
    try {
      // Prefer cards with rich proofs / points
      const candidates = allCards.filter((c) => c.answerPoints.length >= 3);
      const pool = candidates.length > 0 ? candidates : allCards;
      const picked = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];

      const res = await fetch('/api/exam/spot-the-lie', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          card: {
            id: picked.id,
            question: picked.question,
            keyThesis: picked.keyThesis,
            answerPoints: picked.answerPoints,
            examTip: picked.examTip,
          },
          subjectTitle,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось сгенерировать новый раунд');
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      const newRound: SpotTheLieRound = {
        id: `ai-lie-${Date.now()}`,
        category: 'custom',
        title: data.title,
        statement: data.statement,
        steps: data.steps,
        poisonedIndex: data.poisonedIndex,
        fallacyType: data.fallacyType,
        explanation: data.explanation,
        correctStep: data.correctStep,
        linkedCardId: picked.id,
      };
      setRounds((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev, newRound];
        setRoundIdx(next.length - 1);
        return next;
      });
      setSelectedStepIdx(null);
      setTimedOut(false);
      setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      setAiError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка генерации ИИ-раунда',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAi(false);
    }
  }, [allCards, subjectTitle]);

  const handleNextRound = () => {
    if (played >= SESSION_TARGET) {
      setSessionDone(true);
      return;
    }
    if (roundIdx + 1 < rounds.length) {
      setRoundIdx((i) => i + 1);
      setSelectedStepIdx(null);
      setTimedOut(false);
      setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    } else {
      // Out of curated rounds -> auto-generate fresh AI proof from current deck!
      void generateAiRound();
    }
  };

  const handleRestartSession = () => {
    setRounds(shuffle(getCuratedRoundsForCategory(category)));
    setRoundIdx(0);
    setSelectedStepIdx(null);
    setTimedOut(false);
    setTimeLeftMs(ROUND_SECONDS * 1000);
    setScore(0);
    setPlayed(0);
    setStreak(0);
    setBestStreak(0);
    setReactionTimesSec([]);
    setSessionDone(false);
    setAiError('');
  };

  const secDisplay = (timeLeftMs / 1000).toFixed(1);
  const progressPct = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.min(100, (timeLeftMs / (ROUND_SECONDS * 1000)) * 100),
  );
  const timerColor =
    timeLeftMs <= 7500
      ? 'bg-rose-500 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(244,63,94,0.6)]'
      : timeLeftMs <= 15000
        ? 'bg-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)]'
        : 'prism-progress-fill';

  const avgReaction =
    reactionTimesSec.length > 0
      ? (
          reactionTimesSec.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / reactionTimesSec.length
        ).toFixed(1)
      : '—';

  const wasCorrect =
    currentRound !== null && selectedStepIdx === currentRound.poisonedIndex;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Игра Найди ложь за 30 секунд"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#04070D]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl prism-surface rounded-[20px] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200/75 dark:border-white/[0.07] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <div className="h-9 w-9 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/14 border border-rose-500/25 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC] truncate">
                Найди ложь за 30 секунд
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] truncate">
                {subjectTitle} · Ткни в единственную «отравленную» строку доказательства
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0">
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#131B2B] border border-slate-200/75 dark:border-white/[0.07] text-xs font-mono tabular-nums">
              <span className="text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
                Раунд <strong className="text-slate-950 dark:text-white">{Math.min(played + (isResolved ? 0 : 1), SESSION_TARGET)}/{SESSION_TARGET}</strong>
              </span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-slate-300 dark:text-white/15">·</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                {score} верно
              </span>
              {streak >= 2 && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">
                  <Flame className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {streak}×
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              aria-label="Закрыть"
              className="prism-tool-btn p-2 rounded-full text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-7 max-h-[82vh] overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
          {sessionDone ? (
            <div className="py-6 text-center space-y-5">
              <div className="mx-auto h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Trophy className="h-7 w-7" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                  Серия из {played} раундов завершена!
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-[#9CA3AF] max-w-lg mx-auto">
                  {score >= 8
                    ? 'Уровень «Детектор лжи»: на экзамене тебя невозможно подловить на подмене кванторов или скрытом делении на ноль.'
                    : score >= 5
                      ? 'Хорошая хватка! Повтори ещё серию — и логические дыры будут бросаться в глаза мгновенно.'
                      : 'Отличная разминка для внимания — теперь ты точно знаешь главные ловушки экзаменаторов.'}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto">
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Точность</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    {score}/{played}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Макс. комбо</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                    {bestStreak}×
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">Ср. скорость</div>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-xl font-bold font-mono tabular-nums text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">
                    {avgReaction}с
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2.5 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRestartSession}
                  className="prism-cta inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold rounded-full cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Новая серия (10 раундов)</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="prism-tool-btn px-5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium rounded-full text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Вернуться к подготовке
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : isGeneratingAi ? (
            <div className="py-16 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 text-center">
              <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-cyan-400" />
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                Прячем тонкую математическую ловушку в новом доказательстве...
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
                Собираем 6 правдоподобных шагов по билетам «{subjectTitle}»
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : currentRound ? (
            <>
              {/* Timer Bar */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs font-mono tabular-nums">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    <Clock className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${timeLeftMs <= 7500 && !isResolved ? 'text-rose-500 animate-pulse' : 'text-cyan-400'}`} />
                    {isResolved
                      ? timedOut
                        ? 'Время вышло!'
                        : `Ответ дан за ${Math.max(0.4, Number(((ROUND_SECONDS * 1000 - timeLeftMs) / 1000).toFixed(1)))} сек`
                      : `Осталось: ${secDisplay} сек`}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void generateAiRound()}
                    className="prism-tool-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-sans font-medium rounded-full text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Сгенерировать ИИ-ловушку по колоде</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 w-full rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/[0.06] overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className={`h-full transition-all duration-100 ${timerColor}`}
                    style={{width: `${progressPct}%`}}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {aiError && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-rose-500/35 bg-rose-500/10 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
                  {aiError}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Proof Statement Header */}
              <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5">
                <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400/90">
                  Доказательство / вывод
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-1 text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                  {currentRound.title}
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]">
                  {currentRound.statement}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 6 Clickable Steps */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {currentRound.steps.map((step, idx) => {
                  const isPoisoned = idx === currentRound.poisonedIndex;
                  const isPicked = idx === selectedStepIdx;

                  let cardStyle =
                    'border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.07] bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#131B2B]/85 hover:border-cyan-400/55 dark:hover:border-cyan-400/55 hover:bg-cyan-50/50 dark:hover:bg-[#172336] hover:shadow-[0_0_18px_-8px_rgba(34,211,238,0.45)] cursor-pointer';
                  if (isResolved) {
                    if (isPoisoned && isPicked) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-emerald-400/70 bg-emerald-500/14 shadow-[0_0_20px_-6px_rgba(52,211,153,0.45)]';
                    } else if (isPoisoned) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-rose-500/70 bg-rose-500/14 shadow-[0_0_20px_-6px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)]';
                    } else if (isPicked) {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-amber-400/70 bg-amber-500/14';
                    } else {
                      cardStyle =
                        'border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/[0.05] bg-white/50 dark:bg-[#0B101B]/65 opacity-60';
                    }
                  }

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={`${currentRound.id}-step-${idx}`}
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isResolved}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectStep(idx)}
                      className={`w-full text-left rounded-2xl border p-3.5 sm:p-4 transition-all flex items-start gap-3 ${cardStyle}`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`mt-0.5 h-6 w-6 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono tabular-nums font-bold flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          isResolved && isPoisoned
                            ? wasCorrect
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950'
                              : 'bg-rose-500 text-white'
                            : isResolved && isPicked
                              ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#0E1522] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#CBD5E1]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                        <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                          {step.text}
                        </p>
                        {step.latex && (
                          <div className="overflow-x-auto pt-0.5">
                            <MathBlock latex={step.latex} displayMode={false} />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {isResolved && isPoisoned && (
                        <span className="shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-400/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">
                          Ложь
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Verdict & Forensic Explanation */}
              {isResolved && (
                <div
                  className={`rounded-2xl border p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3 ${
                    wasCorrect
                      ? 'border-emerald-400/35 bg-emerald-500/10'
                      : 'border-rose-400/35 bg-rose-500/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {wasCorrect ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                      ) : timedOut ? (
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400" />
                      )}
                      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                        {wasCorrect
                          ? `Поймал ложь! Шаг №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1} разоблачён`
                          : timedOut
                            ? `Не успел — ложь скрывалась в шаге №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1}`
                            : `Промах! Отравлен был шаг №${currentRound.poisonedIndex + 1}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-900/10 dark:bg-white/[0.08] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F8FAFC]">
                      Ловушка: {currentRound.fallacyType}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-sm leading-relaxed text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    {currentRound.explanation}
                  </p>

                  <div className="prism-subpanel rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-[#E5E7EB]">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      Как правильно:{' '}
                    </span>
                    {currentRound.correctStep}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
                    {currentRound.linkedCardId && onOpenCardInDeck ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          onOpenCardInDeck(currentRound.linkedCardId!);
                          onClose();
                        }}
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Открыть связанный билет №{currentRound.linkedCardId} в колоде →
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span />
                    )}

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleNextRound}
                      className="prism-cta inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>
                        {played >= SESSION_TARGET
                          ? 'Показать итоги серии'
                          : 'Следующий раунд'}
                      </span>
                      <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useMemo} from 'react';
import {
  CardSRState,
  DailyActivityMap,
  QuestionChapter,
  StudyCategory,
  StudyPlannerSettings,
  TaskCard,
  TaskMasteryStatus,
  TheoryCard,
} from '../types/study';
import {
  addDaysToDateKey,
  computeActivityStreaks,
  getLocalDateKey,
} from '../utils/cardHelpers';
import {getCardSRState} from '../utils/spacedRepetition';

interface StudyAnalyticsPanelProps {
  category: StudyCategory;
  subjectLabel?: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  tasks: TaskCard[];
  srMap: Record<number, CardSRState>;
  taskMastery: Record<string, TaskMasteryStatus>;
  activityLog: DailyActivityMap;
  plannerSettings: StudyPlannerSettings;
  onUpdatePlanner: (patch: Partial<StudyPlannerSettings>) => void;
  onUpdateExamDate: (category: StudyCategory, dateIso: string) => void;
  onJumpToChapter: (chapter: QuestionChapter) => void;
}

export function StudyAnalyticsPanel({
  category,
  subjectLabel,
  allCards,
  tasks,
  srMap,
  taskMastery,
  activityLog,
  plannerSettings,
  onUpdatePlanner,
  onUpdateExamDate,
  onJumpToChapter,
}: StudyAnalyticsPanelProps) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const examDateIso =
    plannerSettings.examDates[category] ?? addDaysToDateKey(14);
  const displayTargetName =
    category === 'rk'
      ? 'РК 2'
      : category === 'matan'
        ? 'экзамена Матан'
        : category === 'exam'
          ? 'экзамена АИП'
          : subjectLabel || 'экзамена';

  const {todayTotal, bestStreak} = useMemo(
    () => computeActivityStreaks(activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal),
    [activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal],
  );

  const planMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const todayMidnight = new Date(`${getLocalDateKey()}T00:00:00`).getTime();
    const targetMidnight = new Date(`${examDateIso}T00:00:00`).getTime();
    const rawDays = Math.ceil((targetMidnight - todayMidnight) / 86400000);
    const daysLeft = Math.max(1, Number.isFinite(rawDays) ? rawDays : 7);

    let unseenCards = 0;
    let dueReviews = 0;

    for (const c of allCards) {
      const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, c.id);
      if (sr.status === 'unseen') unseenCards++;
      const isOverdue =
        sr.nextReviewAt !== undefined && sr.nextReviewAt <= now;
      if (sr.status === 'hard' || isOverdue) dueReviews++;
    }

    const unsolvedTasks = tasks.filter(
      (t) => (taskMastery[t.id] ?? 'unsolved') !== 'solved',
    ).length;

    const dailyNewCards =
      unseenCards > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unseenCards / daysLeft)) : 0;
    const dailyTasks =
      unsolvedTasks > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unsolvedTasks / daysLeft)) : 0;

    return {
      daysLeft,
      dailyNewCards,
      dueReviews,
      dailyTasks,
    };
  }, [examDateIso, allCards, srMap, tasks, taskMastery, now]);

  const heatmapDays = useMemo(() => {
    const list: {
      key: string;
      label: string;
      total: number;
      reviews: number;
      tasksSolved: number;
      focusMinutes: number;
      level: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
    }[] = [];

    const goal = Math.max(5, plannerSettings.dailyGoal);
    const today = new Date();
    for (let offset = 27; offset >= 0; offset--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() - offset);
      const key = getLocalDateKey(d);
      const entry = activityLog[key];
      const reviews = entry?.reviews ?? 0;
      const tasksSolved = entry?.tasksSolved ?? 0;
      const focusMinutes = entry?.focusMinutes ?? 0;
      const total = reviews + tasksSolved;

      let level: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 = 0;
      if (total > 0) {
        const ratio = total / goal;
        if (ratio >= 1) level = 4;
        else if (ratio >= 0.65) level = 3;
        else if (ratio >= 0.3) level = 2;
        else level = 1;
      }

      const label = d.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short',
      });
      list.push({key, label, total, reviews, tasksSolved, focusMinutes, level});
    }
    return list;
  }, [activityLog, plannerSettings.dailyGoal]);

  const chapterStats = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<
      QuestionChapter,
      {total: number; known: number; weighted: number; lapses: number}
    >();

    for (const c of allCards) {
      const sr = getCardSRState(srMap, c.id);
      const curr = map.get(c.chapter) ?? {
        total: 0,
        known: 0,
        weighted: 0,
        lapses: 0,
      };
      curr.total += 1;
      if (sr.status === 'known') {
        curr.known += 1;
        curr.weighted += 1;
      } else if (sr.status === 'learning') {
        curr.weighted += 0.55;
      } else if (sr.status === 'hard') {
        curr.weighted += 0.2;
      }
      curr.lapses += sr.lapses;
      map.set(c.chapter, curr);
    }

    const rows = Array.from(map.entries()).map(([chapter, stat]) => {
      const pct = Math.round((stat.weighted / Math.max(1, stat.total)) * 100);
      return {
        chapter,
        total: stat.total,
        known: stat.known,
        lapses: stat.lapses,
        pct,
      };
    });

    let weakestChapter: QuestionChapter | null = null;
    if (rows.length > 0) {
      const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.pct !== b.pct) return a.pct - b.pct;
        return b.lapses - a.lapses;
      });
      if (sorted[0].pct < 100) {
        weakestChapter = sorted[0].chapter;
      }
    }

    return {rows, weakestChapter};
  }, [allCards, srMap]);

  const dailyPct = Math.min(
    100,

                    className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-mono tabular-nums rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${

                style={{width: `${dailyPct}%`}}

            </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-14 gap-1.5">
            {heatmapDays.map((day) => (
              <div
                key={day.key}
                title={`${day.label}: ${day.reviews} карт., ${day.tasksSolved} зад., ${day.focusMinutes} мин фокуса`}
                className={`aspect-square rounded-[4px] border transition-colors ${heatColor(day.level)}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-[#9CA3AF]">
            <span>{heatmapDays[0]?.label}</span>
            <span>Сегодня ({heatmapDays[heatmapDays.length - 1]?.label})</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Column 2: Weak Topics Map by Chapter */}
      <div className="lg:col-span-6 prism-subpanel rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">

              Карта тем и слабых мест (клик — перейти к теме)
            </span>

              Глав: {chapterStats.rows.length}

          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[245px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">

              return (
                <button
                  key={row.chapter}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onJumpToChapter(row.chapter)}
                  className="w-full text-left rounded-xl border border-slate-200/75 dark:border-white/[0.06] bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#0E1522]/90 hover:border-cyan-400/50 dark:hover:border-cyan-400/45 p-2.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs mb-1.5">
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6] truncate">
                      {row.chapter}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
                      {isWeakest && (

                          Слабое место
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                        {row.known}/{row.total} ({row.pct}%)
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200/75 dark:bg-white/[0.06] overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className={`h-full transition-all duration-200 ${
                        row.pct >= 75
                          ? 'prism-progress-fill'
                          : row.pct >= 35
                            ? 'bg-cyan-400'
                            : 'bg-rose-500'
                      }`}
                      style={{width: `${row.pct}%`}}
                    />
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import {useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Download,
  Headphones,
  Loader2,
  Pause,
  Play,
  RotateCcw,
  Sparkles,
  Volume2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {CardSRState, TheoryCard} from '../types/study';
import {getCardSRState, getCardUrgencyScore} from '../utils/spacedRepetition';

interface StudyPodcastModalProps {
  subjectTitle: string;
  allCards: TheoryCard[];
  srMap: Record<number, CardSRState>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface PodcastLine {
  speaker: string;
  text: string;
}

interface PodcastSegment {
  segmentType: 'intro' | 'prompt' | 'answer' | 'outro';
  cardId?: number;
  heading: string;
  pauseAfterSec: number;
  lines: PodcastLine[];
}

interface SegmentTiming {
  heading: string;
  cardId?: number;
  startSec: number;
  endSec: number;
}

const SPEED_OPTIONS = [0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.25, 1.4];

function formatTime(sec: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(sec) || sec < 0) return '0:00';
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
  return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function base64ToBlobUrl(base64: string, mimeType: string): {url: string; blob: Blob} {
  const binary = window.atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) {
    bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], {type: mimeType});
  return {url: URL.createObjectURL(blob), blob};
}

export function StudyPodcastModal({
  subjectTitle,
  allCards,
  srMap,
  onClose,
}: StudyPodcastModalProps) {
  // Rank weakest / hardest / due cards first
  const rankedCards = useMemo(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    return [...allCards].sort((a, b) => {
      const sa = getCardUrgencyScore(getCardSRState(srMap, a.id), now);
      const sb = getCardUrgencyScore(getCardSRState(srMap, b.id), now);
      return sb - sa;
    });
  }, [allCards, srMap]);

  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<number[]>(() =>
    rankedCards.slice(0, Math.min(3, rankedCards.length)).map((c) => c.id),
  );
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<'dialogue' | 'solo'>('dialogue');
  const [voicePreset, setVoicePreset] = useState<'Charon' | 'Zephyr' | 'Kore'>('Charon');
  const [paceMode, setPaceMode] = useState<'brisk' | 'calm'>('brisk');

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'setup' | 'scripting' | 'voicing' | 'ready'>('setup');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const [episodeTitle, setEpisodeTitle] = useState('');
  const [segments, setSegments] = useState<PodcastSegment[]>([]);
  const [timings, setTimings] = useState<SegmentTiming[]>([]);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [audioBlob, setAudioBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);
  // Default moderately brisk speed (1.1x) as requested!
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1.1);

  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (audioUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
    };
  }, [audioUrl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (audioRef.current) {
      audioRef.current.playbackRate = playbackRate;
    }
  }, [playbackRate, audioUrl]);

  // Register MediaSession so lock-screen controls work in the metro / pocket!
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!audioUrl || !('mediaSession' in navigator)) return;
    try {
      navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({
        title: episodeTitle || `Аудиоразбор · ${subjectTitle}`,
        artist: format === 'dialogue' ? 'Артём и Алиса · Учебный подкаст' : 'Учебный подкаст',
        album: subjectTitle,
      });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('play', () => {
        void audioRef.current?.play();
      });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('pause', () => {
        audioRef.current?.pause();
      });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('seekbackward', () => {
        if (audioRef.current) {
          audioRef.current.currentTime = Math.max(0, audioRef.current.currentTime - 10);
        }
      });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('seekforward', () => {
        if (audioRef.current) {
          audioRef.current.currentTime = Math.min(
            audioRef.current.duration || 0,
            audioRef.current.currentTime + 10,
          );
        }
      });
    } catch {
      // ignore unsupported MediaSession handlers
    }
  }, [audioUrl, episodeTitle, subjectTitle, format]);

  const toggleCardSelection = (id: number) => {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      if (prev.includes(id)) {
        return prev.length > 1 ? prev.filter((x) => x !== id) : prev;
      }
      if (prev.length >= 5) return prev;
      return [...prev, id];
    });
  };

  const handleGeneratePodcast = async () => {
    const pickedCards = allCards.filter((c) => selectedIds.includes(c.id));
    if (pickedCards.length === 0) return;

    setError('');
    setPhase('scripting');
    if (audioUrl) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(audioUrl);
      setAudioUrl(null);
      setAudioBlob(null);
    }

    try {
      // Step 1: Generate natural conversational Russian script with spoken math + 5s pauses
      const scriptRes = await fetch('/api/exam/podcast-script', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          subjectTitle,
          format,
          paceMode,
          cards: pickedCards.map((c) => ({
            id: c.id,
            question: c.question,
            keyThesis: c.keyThesis,
            answerPoints: c.answerPoints,
            examTip: c.examTip,
          })),
        }),
      });
      if (!scriptRes.ok) {
        const body = await scriptRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось написать сценарий подкаста');
      }
      const scriptData = (await scriptRes.json()) as {
        episodeTitle: string;
        segments: PodcastSegment[];
      };

      setEpisodeTitle(scriptData.episodeTitle);
      setSegments(scriptData.segments);
      setPhase('voicing');

      // Step 2: Synthesize natural non-robotic neural speech via gemini-3.8-flash-tts + stitch pauses into 1 WAV
      const audioRes = await fetch('/api/exam/podcast-audio', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        body: JSON.stringify({
          segments: scriptData.segments,
          format,
          voicePreset,
          paceMode,
        }),
      });
      if (!audioRes.ok) {
        const body = await audioRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Не удалось озвучить выпуск');
      }
      const audioData = (await audioRes.json()) as {
        audioBase64: string;
        mimeType: string;
        durationSec: number;
        segmentTimings: SegmentTiming[];
      };

      const {url, blob} = base64ToBlobUrl(audioData.audioBase64, audioData.mimeType || 'audio/wav');
      setAudioUrl(url);
      setAudioBlob(blob);
      setTimings(audioData.segmentTimings ?? []);
      setDuration(audioData.durationSec || 0);
      setCurrentTime(0);
      setPhase('ready');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Ошибка создания подкаста');
      setPhase('setup');
    }
  };

  const handleTogglePlay = () => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    if (el.paused) {
      el.playbackRate = playbackRate;
      void el.play();
    } else {
      el.pause();
    }
  };

  const handleSeek = (sec: number) => {
    const el = audioRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.currentTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(duration || el.duration || 0, sec));
    setCurrentTime(el.currentTime);
  };

  const handleDownloadWav = () => {
    if (!audioBlob) return;
    const dlUrl = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = dlUrl;
    const safeSlug = subjectTitle.replace(/[^a-zA-Zа-яА-Я0-9]+/g, '_').slice(0, 30);
    a.download = `podcast_${safeSlug}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.wav`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(dlUrl);
  };

  const activeSegmentIndex = useMemo(() => {
    if (timings.length === 0) return -1;
    const idx = timings.findIndex(
      (t) => currentTime >= t.startSec && currentTime < t.endSec,
    );
    return idx >= 0 ? idx : currentTime >= (timings[timings.length - 1]?.endSec ?? 0) ? timings.length - 1 : 0;
  }, [timings, currentTime]);

  return (
    <div

      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Личный аудиоподкаст по слабым темам"

    >
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-auto">

                              : sr.status === 'unseen'

                          {sr.status === 'hard'
                            ? 'Сложно'
                            : sr.status === 'unseen'
                              ? 'Новое'

                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <button

              <div className="text-base font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                {phase === 'scripting'
                  ? 'Пишем живой сценарий без робо-штампов...'
                  : 'Озвучиваем выпуск живыми нейронными голосами и вшиваем паузы...'}

              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8] max-w-md">

                  : 'Обычно занимает 15–35 секунд. После этого выпуск можно слушать с выключенным экраном и скачать как WAV.'}

                onPause={() => setIsPlaying(false)}

                onTimeUpdate={(e) => setCurrentTime(e.currentTarget.currentTime)}
                onLoadedMetadata={(e) => {
                  if (Number.isFinite(e.currentTarget.duration)) {
                    setDuration(e.currentTarget.duration);
                  }
                  e.currentTarget.playbackRate = playbackRate;
                }}
              />

              {/* Player Card */}
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-cyan-200/80 dark:border-cyan-500/25 bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-50/70 to-slate-50 dark:from-[#131B2B] dark:to-[#0B101B] p-5 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-sky-700 dark:text-sky-400">
                      {format === 'dialogue' ? 'Артём и Алиса · Живой разбор' : 'Соло-выпуск · Наставник'}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                      {episodeTitle}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleDownloadWav}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Скачать WAV (офлайн)</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        audioRef.current?.pause();
                        setPhase('setup');
                      }}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/[0.08] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB] hover:bg-white/60 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Новый</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Seek Bar */}
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min={0}
                    max={Math.max(1, duration)}
                    step={0.1}
                    value={Math.min(currentTime, Math.max(1, duration))}
                    onChange={(e) => handleSeek(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-sky-600 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                    <span>{formatTime(currentTime)}</span>
                    <span>{formatTime(duration)}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Controls + Speed */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSeek(currentTime - 10)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      −10с
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleTogglePlay}
                      className="h-11 w-11 rounded-full prism-cta flex items-center justify-center shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                      aria-label={isPlaying ? 'Пауза' : 'Воспроизвести'}
                    >
                      {isPlaying ? (
                        <Pause className="h-5 w-5" />
                      ) : (
                        <Play className="h-5 w-5 ml-0.5" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleSeek(currentTime + 10)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-semibold rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#131B2B] text-slate-700 dark:text-[#E5E7EB] hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-[#182235] cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      +10с
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Speed Pills */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Volume2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-500 mr-1" />
                    {SPEED_OPTIONS.map((sp) => (
                      <button
                        key={sp}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setPlaybackRate(sp)}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-semibold rounded-md cursor-pointer ${
                          playbackRate === sp
                            ? 'prism-cta'
                            : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-[#94A3B8] hover:bg-slate-200/70 dark:hover:bg-[#182235]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {sp}×
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Synchronized Transcript / Chapters */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]">
                  Главы и расшифровка (нажми на блок, чтобы перемотать)
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {segments.map((seg, idx) => {
                    const timing = timings[idx];
                    const isActive = idx === activeSegmentIndex;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={`${seg.heading}-${idx}`}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (timing) {
                            handleSeek(timing.startSec);
                            if (audioRef.current?.paused) {
                              void audioRef.current.play();
                            }
                          }
                        }}
                        className={`w-full text-left rounded-xl border p-3.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          isActive
                            ? 'border-sky-500 bg-sky-50/70 dark:bg-sky-950/30'
                            : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/[0.08] bg-white dark:bg-[#0E1522] hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-[#3A3A3A]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-[#F3F4F6]">
                            {seg.heading}
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-[#94A3B8]">
                            {seg.pauseAfterSec >= 2 && (
                              <span className="text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 font-sans font-semibold">
                                + пауза {seg.pauseAfterSec}с на ответ
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {timing && <span>{formatTime(timing.startSec)}</span>}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          {seg.lines.map((line, lIdx) => (
                            <p
                              key={lIdx}
                              className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700 dark:text-[#D1D5DB]"
                            >
                              <strong className="text-slate-950 dark:text-white">
                                {line.speaker}:{' '}
                              </strong>
                              {line.text}
                            </p>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
